Our current platform works, but the design does not match the quality of what we put on it. That is what you are here to fix.



The project

A complete redesign of the member-facing experience across three surfaces:

1. Desktop web — the full logged-out and logged-in experience

2. Mobile web — responsive, treated as a first-class surface and not an afterthought

3. Native mobile apps — iOS and Android



The platform runs on a third-party OTT solution. We want ambitious work that our development partner can actually implement. We will give you access to the current product and technical context so you can design against real constraints.

We have an existing brand: fonts, colours, tone of voice and visual direction are set. You are designing within it and sharpening it, not replacing it.

* Landing and homepage (conversion-focused)

* Category, collection and curated-selection pages

* Title detail pages for films, series and documentaries

* Video player interface and all its states

* Search, filtering and empty states

* Continue watching, watchlist and viewing history

* Masterclass and live session pages, including registration and reminders

* Community section

* Account, profile and subscription management, including upgrade, downgrade and cancellation

App-specific:

* Native navigation patterns for iOS and Android

* Downloads and offline viewing

* Audio-only / podcast mode

* Push notification and permission moments

* Casting to TV

What you will deliver

* High-fidelity UI designs in Figma for every screen and state listed above, in light and dark theme. We will give you guidance in how we want it!

* A design system — components with variants and auto layout, colour and typography tokens, spacing scale, iconography, states and interaction rules, documented so a developer can read it without asking you

* Responsive specifications — breakpoints and behaviour rules for desktop, tablet and mobile web

* Developer handoff documentation — clean, organised, annotated Figma files with naming conventions our development partner can work from

Everything lives in a single well-structured Figma file or project that we own.

How we work

* Weekly review calls, with written async updates in between

* We work in phases. Each phase is approved before the next starts.

* You will get direct access to decision-makers. Feedback is fast, direct and honest. we expect the same from you. If you think a request is wrong, say so.

Requirements

* 3+ years designing consumer-facing digital products, both web and native mobile

* Expert-level Figma — auto layout, components, variants, variables and tokens, prototyping. This is not negotiable; we will look at your file structure, not just your screens.

* A portfolio showing at least a few responsive web products and at least a few native mobile apps you designed end to end

* Genuine understanding of video and OTT interface patterns — content rails, player controls, browse hierarchies, continue watching, metadata density

* Working knowledge of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design, and the discipline to respect platform conventions rather than copy-pasting one design across both

* Understanding of subscription and conversion design — you know that a pricing page is a commercial instrument, not decoration

* Experience building or maintaining a design system

* Accessibility fundamentals — contrast, focus states, touch targets, WCAG AA awareness

* Comfortable designing inside an existing brand and within platform limitations

* Strong written English and self-directed async communication

* Able to overlap at least 3 hours per day with Central European Time (CET/Amsterdam)

* Reliable internet, your own computer, and a stable working setup

Nice to have

* Experience with streaming, OTT, membership or e-learning products

* Motion and micro-interaction design, Lottie

* Experience designing around white-label or templated platforms and their constraints

* Multi-language interface design (English and Dutch)

* Basic understanding of front-end implementation, enough to know what is cheap and what is expensive to build

How to apply

Start your reply with the word TTS. Applications that do not begin with TTS will not be read. We want to know you actually read this.

Then include:

1. A link to your portfolio. Live Figma files or full case studies tell us far more than image galleries. show us your thinking, not only your pixels.

2. One specific example of a redesign you did where you can explain the problem, your decision and the result.

3. Your answer to this question: which streaming or membership product do you think has the best user experience right now, and what is the single thing it does that most others get wrong?

4. Your rate, your availability per week, and the earliest date you can start.

5. Which time zone you work in and your normal working hours.

Please do not send a generic or AI-written application. We read every reply and we can tell.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video call and a short paid test assignment. So we can both see how we work together before committing to the full project.

title: E-Commerce Operations & Management Virtual Assistant
description:
Summary



We are looking for a highly capable, proactive, and technically minded Virtual Assistant with previous management, supervisory, or team leadership experience.



This role will focus on Amazon advertising analysis, Amazon product and keyword research, inventory management, data analysis, Canva photo and video editing, and supporting the overall organization and improvement of our Amazon business.



Prior Amazon experience is strongly preferred but is not required. We are willing to train the right person.



The ideal candidate is highly analytical, comfortable with technology, learns new software and systems quickly, and can work independently without requiring constant supervision. A background in engineering, computer science, information technology, data analysis, mathematics, or another technical field is strongly preferred.



A major goal of this position is to find someone who can grow beyond completing individual tasks. The right candidate may eventually manage other VAs, if highly capable, potentially take on broader management responsibilities overseeing additional virtual assistants.



Required Conditions



Please read all REQUIRED conditions below before applying.



REQUIRED: Strong English communication skills for
s, meetings, training, management, and project updates.

REQUIRED: Previous management, supervisory, team-lead, operations, or project-management experience.

REQUIRED: Strong technical aptitude and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar software, systems, and business processes.

REQUIRED: Strong analytical and numerical skills, including the ability to review data, identify trends, recognize problems, and make logical recommendations.

REQUIRED: Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills and comfort working with spreadsheets, formulas, reports, and large amounts of data.

REQUIRED: Reliable internet connection



Application Instructions



When applying, you MUST include the following sentence in the subject line or as the first sentence of your message:

“I have management or leadership experience, strong technical and analytical skills, and I am interested in learning and taking ownership of Amazon e-commerce operations.”



Applications that do not include this sentence will be automatically discarded.



Please include a link to your CV or resume and briefly describe your:



- Management, supervisory, or team leadership experience

- Educational background, especially engineering, computer science, IT, mathematics, analytics, or other technical fields

- Experience with Excel and/or Google Sheets

- Amazon or e-commerce experience, if any

- Experience with Amazon Seller Central, Amazon advertising, product research, keyword research, or inventory management, if any

- Experience with Jungle Scout, Keepa, Helium 10, or similar tools, if any

- Experience with Canva, photo editing, or video editing

- Experience using AI and other technology tools



Primary Responsibilities



- Analyze Amazon advertising performance and identify trends, problems, and opportunities

- Review advertising data including sales, spend, ACOS, ROAS, conversion rates, keywords, search terms, and other performance indicators

- Prepare clear Amazon advertising reports and recommendations

- Conduct Amazon product research and evaluate potential product opportunities

- Research competitors, pricing, sales estimates, reviews, product trends, and market conditions

- Conduct Amazon keyword research and analyze keyword relevance, search volume, competition, ranking, and performance

- Use Jungle Scout, Keepa, Helium 10, and other Amazon research tools

- Monitor Amazon inventory levels, sales velocity, inbound inventory, and potential stock-out risks

- Assist with inventory forecasting and reorder planning

- Maintain organized spreadsheets, reports, dashboards, and research files

- Create and edit basic product graphics, marketing materials, photos, and short videos using Canva

- Attend collaborative work sessions and review priorities with the client

- Provide clear progress updates and document completed work

- Identify problems, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement without waiting to be asked

- Create and improve processes, checklists, SOPs, and documentation



Preferred Experience & Skills



- Previous management, supervisory, team-lead, operations, or project-management experience

- Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills

- Engineering, computer science, information technology, mathematics, statistics, data analysis, or similar technical background

- Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills

- Experience supporting an Amazon or e-commerce business

- Experience with Canva, photo editing, or video editing

- Experience creating SOPs, checklists, processes, and quality-control systems

- Ability to communicate clearly, respectfully, and professionally

- Self-starter who takes initiative and thinks ahead



The following experience is considered a plus but is not required:



- Engineering degree or professional engineering experience

- Computer science, programming, or IT experience

- Data analytics or business intelligence experience

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets experience

- SQL, Python, scripting, Google Apps Script, or similar technical skills

- Workflow automation experience

- Experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools for business applications

- Amazon PPC campaign management experience

- Amazon FBA inventory management

- Experience supervising Amazon analysts or e-commerce employees

- Experience managing larger remote or virtual teams



Stretch Goals / Responsibilities



- As the candidate becomes trained and demonstrates strong performance, the role may expand to include independently managing Amazon advertising analysis, product and keyword research, inventory planning, Amazon reporting, and other e-commerce operations.

- The candidate may also take responsibility for managing two existing Amazon analysts, reviewing their work, establishing deadlines and quality-control processes, providing training, monitoring performance, and ensuring projects are completed accurately and on time.

- For an exceptionally capable candidate, the role may eventually expand into a broader management position overseeing additional virtual assistants and potentially helping manage a remote team of approximately 10–15 people.

- The long-term goal is to develop this person into a trusted Amazon and operations leader who can identify problems before they become urgent, improve systems and processes, train others, make recommendations, and take increasing responsibility without requiring constant supervision.



Keywords



Amazon Virtual Assistant, Amazon VA, Amazon Operations Assistant, Amazon Operations Manager, E-commerce Virtual Assistant, E-commerce Operations, Technical Virtual Assistant, Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Advertising, Amazon PPC, Amazon Ads Analysis, Amazon Product Research, Amazon Keyword Research, Amazon Keyword Analysis, Amazon Inventory Management, Amazon FBA, Jungle Scout, Keepa, Helium 10, Excel, Google Sheets, Data Analysis, Canva, Photo Editing, Video Editing, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Operations Management, Team Management, Project Management, Process Improvement, SOP Development, AI Tools

description:

I am looking for someone who understands the meaning of what is being said and can choose B-roll that actually fits the topic and context.



For example, if the speaker is talking about a specific country, city, type of person, business, environment, event, or situation, the footage should visually match that context.



I do not want random stock footage that is only loosely related.



Very important:



- Real footage only

- No AI-generated footage

- No AI-generated people

- No AI-generated images used as B-roll

- No AI-generated scenes

- The B-roll must be selected based on actual context and relevance



Requirements:

- Adobe Premiere Pro

- Basic conversational English

- Strong sense of timing and pacing

- Captions/subtitles

- Effects and transitions

- Good visual judgment

- Ability to work independently

. Applications sent outside OnlineJobs will not be considered.

 where the B-roll should appear

title: Full Stack and Mobile Developer, AI and Integrations
description:
We are an internationally operating digital marketing agency working with clients across different countries and industries.

We are looking for a reliable and proactive Full Stack and Mobile Developer to join our team on a long term basis. The position can be part time or full time, but in both cases we expect strong commitment, consistent availability and genuine ownership of the work.

You will contribute to websites, web applications, mobile applications, internal tools, dashboards, API integrations and AI powered features. You will often receive a business objective, design, concept or existing prototype and be responsible for turning it into a reliable, maintainable solution.

This is not a short term freelance project. We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our team and grow with the agency.



Your responsibilities

Build and maintain frontend, backend and mobile features.

Develop responsive web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Next.js.

Develop and maintain mobile applications using React Native, Flutter or native technologies.

Build backend functionality using Node.js and/or Python.

Translate designs, prototypes and business concepts into production ready solutions.

Integrate third party APIs, databases, webhooks and external platforms.

Design logical data flows between frontend applications, backend systems, databases and external services.

Build AI powered features and automations using Claude, ChatGPT and related APIs.

Work with Claude Code, Cursor or comparable AI assisted development tools.

Improve prototype and AI generated code before it is used in production.

Debug technical issues and take responsibility for the reliability of what you deliver.

Write clean, tested and maintainable code.

Use Git and GitHub professionally and contribute to code reviews.

Communicate progress, challenges and technical decisions clearly.



Essential skills and experience

At least 2 years of professional experience in full stack development.

Strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills.

Professional experience with React and preferably Next.js.

Professional mobile development experience with React Native, Flutter or native technologies.

Backend development experience with Node.js and/or Python.

Experience integrating REST APIs, JSON, webhooks and third party services.

Good understanding of databases, data modelling and SQL.

Ability to connect frontend, backend, mobile applications, databases and external platforms.

Experience with Git, GitHub and modern deployment workflows.

Hands on experience building AI features, agents, integrations or automations using Claude, ChatGPT or similar APIs.

Strong debugging, logical thinking and problem solving skills.

Ability to work confidently within existing codebases.



Communication and working style

Strong spoken and written English is essential. Our agency works internationally, and you will communicate with team members and potentially clients from different countries.

You should be someone who:

Communicates clearly and professionally.

Takes ownership instead of waiting for detailed instructions at every step.

Thinks logically and understands the wider objective behind a task.

Raises questions or potential problems early.

Provides transparent progress updates.

Works independently while remaining closely connected to the team.

Is dependable and follows through on agreed responsibilities.

Is open to feedback and interested in continuously improving.



Commitment

Our team operates primarily in Europe (CET/CEST). Write "REMOTE" to make sure you have read the full job description at the beginning of your Cover letter.



You do not need to be based in Europe, but you must be able to provide reliable overlap with European working hours for communication, collaboration and scheduled meetings.



Part-time applicants should provide consistent weekly availability. Full-time applicants should be prepared to make this their primary professional role.



Desirable experience

Previous experience within a digital agency, startup or international remote team.

Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar development tools.

PostgreSQL, Supabase or comparable database technologies.

Vercel and cloud deployment.

n8n, Make, Zapier or similar automation platforms.

Google APIs, SEO platforms, analytics tools or reporting dashboards.

Data extraction and web scraping.

Figma and a basic understanding of UX and responsive design.



How to apply

Please include:

A short introduction.

Whether you are applying for a part time or full time position.

Your availability, time zone and expected monthly compensation.

Your GitHub profile, portfolio or examples of relevant work.

Examples of web and mobile applications you have developed.

At least one example of an AI powered feature, integration or automation you have built.

A short explanation of your personal contribution to each project.

We are especially interested in understanding how you solve problems, communicate and take ownership, not only which technologies you have used.

title: SEO Specialist
description:
Company Overview:

We are a Digital Marketing Agency based in Atlanta, GA.

We've been in this industry since year 2000 (23 years & counting).

We provide a full range of marketing services to small and mid-size businesses.

Our success is a result of coordinating the right people's talent with client projects to provide exceptional marketing strategies and tactics.





Role Overview

As an SEO , you will be responsible for developing and implementing effective SEO strategies to improve the online visibility & organic search rankings of our own & client’s websites.





Responsibilities & Duties:

* Keep abreast of the latest developments in SEO, search engine algorithms, and digital marketing trends. Identify emerging opportunities and make recommendations for optimization and improvement.

* Developing & executing SEO strategies:

Provide keyword analysis and performance then execute strategies. Create and implement comprehensive SEO strategies that align with the company's goals and target audience. This includes keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO, link building, and content optimization.

* In-depth understanding of link building best practices and backlink analysis. Develop and execute a strategy to acquire backlinks that will positively impact organic search visibility.

* Keyword research and analysis:

Conduct in-depth keyword research to identify relevant search terms and phrases. Analyze keyword competitiveness, search volume, and user intent to optimize website content and drive organic traffic. Increasing ranking and relevance of websites by acquiring high-quality link placements on websites with good PA/DA scores.

* On-page and technical optimization:

Optimize website content, meta tags, headings, URLs, and other on-page elements to improve organic search rankings. Ensure proper implementation of technical SEO best practices, including website speed optimization, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and schema markup.

* Off-page optimization and link building:

Develop and execute link-building strategies to acquire high-quality backlinks from authoritative websites. Monitor and analyze backlink profiles, disavow spammy links, and identify opportunities for link acquisition.

* SEO analytics and reporting:

Monitor and analyze website performance using SEO tools and web analytics platforms. Generate regular reports on key SEO metrics, such as organic traffic, keyword rankings, conversion rates, and backlink profile. Provide actionable insights and recommendations based on data analysis.

* Optimize WordPress websites for search engines (SEO) and implement basic SEO best practices to improve organic visibility and rankings.

* Content optimization:

Collaborate with content writers to optimize website content, including blog posts, articles, product descriptions, & landing pages. Ensure content is relevant, engaging, and optimized for target keywords.

* Work closely with the marketing team: SEO, content, web development, and design team to align SEO strategies with overall marketing objectives. Provide guidance and recommendations for SEO best practices in website design, content creation, & user experience.





Required Experience and Skills

* Proven experience as an SEO 

* In-depth knowledge of SEO techniques, tools, and best practices.

* Expertise in SEO techniques, analytics, and industry trends will be crucial in achieving our digital marketing goals.

* Excellent skills in web analytics tools, such as Google Analytics & Search Console.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

* Strong attention to detail and a proactive mindset.

title: Financial Controller | UK-based
description:
A CFO overseeing a portfolio of fast-growing, product-based and retail brands across the UK is looking to build up the capability of the finance function properly, not just keep it running as is.



Right now, the CFO handles the bulk of the accounting personally, bookkeeping through to forecasting, across every business in the portfolio. We're hiring a Financial Controller to take full ownership of that function and build it into something stronger, working closely with the CFO throughout rather than inheriting it in isolation.



This is a senior, hands-on role built around real ownership, not a narrow, single-client bookkeeping job. The portfolio is kept deliberately focused, so the role is about doing the work well, not managing volume.



Because the businesses in the portfolio vary in size, sector and complexity, the scope of this role will shift as needs change. You'll need to be comfortable adapting to what each client requires rather than working from a fixed, unchanging list of tasks.



Important



This role isn't suited to someone who wants to keep their head down and do the basics. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of problems from discovery through to resolution, who questions how things are done and pushes for a better way when something doesn't add up, and who can hold a confident, informed conversation with the CFO about the numbers.



This is not a client-facing role. The CFO keeps direct client relationships and calls; your focus is on building and running the finance function itself.



What You'll Be Responsible For



Financial Reporting & Accounting

- Month-end close and management reporting across multiple client accounts

- Maintaining accurate financial records and reconciliations

- Supporting year-end accounting



Inventory & Operational Finance

- Inventory and landed cost accounting

- Retail deductions and operational finance support

- Managing and reconciling large datasets across multiple systems



Forecasting & Analysis

- Building and maintaining financial models, forecasts and cash flow projections

- Investigating and resolving discrepancies and variances independently

- Ad hoc financial and operational analysis



Process & Relationship Ownership

- Improving finance processes and workflows across the portfolio

- Running the day-to-day finance function with minimal oversight

- Bringing issues and improvement ideas to the CFO with confidence, not just waiting to be asked



What We're Looking For

- Genuinely proactive: you notice when something doesn't add up or a process doesn't make sense, and you push to fix it rather than working around it

- Proven experience running a finance function independently, not just contributing to one within a larger team

- Experience managing the finance function across multiple client accounts or entities at once, comfortable prioritising and moving between businesses of different sizes and complexity

- Genuine hands-on experience building management accounts and forecasts from scratch

- Comfortable producing forward-looking analysis and insight, not only reviewing and flagging issues in bookkeeping

- Strong accounting background with real exposure to product-based or inventory-heavy businesses

- Hands-on experience with inventory accounting, landed costs, reconciliations and operational finance workflows

- Experience with Amazon or e-commerce accounting operations and large transaction datasets

- Fluent in tools such as Xero, Zoho Books, QuickBooks Online and BI or reporting platforms

- CPA preferred or other similar certifications

- A confident, articulate communicator who is comfortable pushing back and defending their analysis with sound reasoning

- Naturally investigative, someone who wants to understand a business well enough to question its numbers, not simply record them

- Retail or wholesale accounting experience is a strong advantage



Working Setup

Working Setup

This is a fully remote, full-time position working UK business hours. To be considered for this role, you must have:

- A reliable computer suitable for remote work

- A fast, stable primary internet connection, with a backup option available in case of an outage

- A quiet, professional workspace free from background noise and interruptions

- A good quality headset for clear communication

- A dedicated work environment where you can attend meetings and work without distractions



What Success Looks Like In This Role

Success in this role means leadership can confidently rely on you to own the numbers, reporting, forecasting, and finance operations without needing constant oversight.

title: AI Growth Builder & Outbound Marketer (we build our own): property tech + new SaaS, remote
description:
AI Growth Builder and Outbound Marketer (global outreach), remote



The short version

We are a European property-tech group, and we are building something bigger. We need someone who uses AI to reach the right people in every market and turns that reach into real action on our platforms: agents listing their properties and getting viewings booked, agencies coming on board. Think AI-driven
, AI calling, and social outreach that gets people to like and share, country by country, in the local language. Important: we build and own our systems. We are not looking for someone who rents a pile of subscriptions, we want someone who builds the engine with us so we own it and reuse it. On top of that, you can pick up the broader marketing work too: content, social, basic SEO, paid, analytics.



Who we are

We run several live rental and property platforms in the European market on one shared codebase, plus a new SaaS for the staffing and recruitment sector. We move fast, we test thoroughly, and we reward people who prove results.



How we work (important)

- We build and own our tools. We prefer building over renting. Less vendor lock-in, more control, and everything we build we reuse across our platforms.

- That means working at the level of APIs, your own scripts, and your own automations, not clicking together a stack of expensive closed services.

- You build it once, we own it, and it keeps paying off across every channel and every country.



What you will do (the core)

- Build AI-powered, multi-channel outreach that we own and that scales worldwide, market by market:
 at volume, AI calling, social, and WhatsApp where it fits.

- For the property platform: reach real estate agents in every market and bring them onto the platform, listing their properties and getting viewings booked. The AI calls and messages carry one clear call to action: visit the site and get started.

- For the SaaS: reach staffing and recruitment agencies and get them on board and active in the same way.

- It is one engine for both products. You build it once and it runs for property and for staffing, country by country.

- Make it work in any language. Build a reliable localization approach so the outreach reads native in each market, using AI translation with quality control and native review where it matters. Rough machine translation does not cut it; the message has to feel local, not foreign.

- Drive social amplification: get agents and agencies to follow, like, and share our content, so reach compounds.

- Build the lead data, sequences, and automations yourself, and keep them deliverable and legal in every market you touch: GDPR in Europe, anti-spam laws such as CAN-SPAM, and local rules on
 and automated calling. Warmed domains, clear opt-out, and consent where it is required. Compliance and deliverability are part of the job, not an afterthought.

- Measure everything: replies, signups, activations, and double down on what works.



What you will do (the bonus, all-round)

- Content and social management, basic SEO, paid campaigns, simple design, reporting.



How you build it (we like builders, not renters)

- Comfortable wiring up LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) in your own workflows.

- Comfortable with self-hostable automation (for example n8n) and your own scripts over closed SaaS where it makes sense.

- Can build your own lead data, localization, and outreach pipeline instead of depending on one paid platform.

- For AI calling, you wire telephony and voice models yourself rather than relying on a closed black box.

If you already build your own automations instead of renting them, tell us. That is exactly who we want.



Who you are

- You think in systems and you build and own them.

- You have grown something real and can show it, with a number.

- You are comfortable with volume, testing, and iteration.

- You write clear English, and you have a proven way to make outreach read natively in many other languages (AI localization with quality control, native review where it matters). You do not rely on rough machine translation.

- You respect the law in each country you reach into, and you treat compliance as part of doing it well, not a brake. You know that automated calling in particular is tightly regulated and you handle it carefully, market by market.

- You are self-starting and reliable, and you keep brands safe (no spammy shortcuts that get domains blacklisted).



The deal

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property/SaaS-tech, remote)
description:
Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

High Point International Inc. helps B2B SaaS executives build high-conviction growth engines. We are looking for an analytical, hands-on growth strategist to bridge the gap between ad spend and bottom-line revenue.



Mission



Drive scalable pipeline growth for B2B SaaS clients by executing full-funnel paid media campaigns and establishing closed-loop CRM attribution. You will solve tracking blind spots, optimize multi-channel performance, and deliver clear, data-backed acquisition strategies that translate marketing investments into qualified demos, pipeline, and predictable revenue.

Strong proficiency in AutoCAD; Revit and Bluebeam Revu experience strongly preferred. Solid understanding of takeoff methods and construction means and methods. Excellent written and spoken English — you will be communicating directly with US-based staff and occasionally with clients. Experience with PlanSwift, RoofSnap, or similar takeoff tools. Prior experience working with American contractors or design-build firms.



What We Offer

Competitive pay benchmarked to your skill level and experience, with raises tied to performance. Long-term, stable work — we are looking to build a relationship, not fill a one-off project. Paid time off after probation. Christmas bonus (13th month equivalent). Direct mentorship from experienced US-based PMs and estimators. Flexible schedule once you're up to speed.



How to Apply

Please send (1) your updated CV, (2) a portfolio or 2–3 sample drawings you have personally produced (PDF preferred), (3) a brief paragraph describing your most challenging project and your specific role on it, and (4) your expected monthly salary in USD.

We look forward to meeting you.

title: Recruitment Resourcer / Candidate Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are a fast-growing UK recruitment and technology business looking for a motivated Recruitment Resourcer to join our team.



Your main responsibility will be supporting the candidate side of our recruitment process — sourcing, screening and managing candidates against live vacancies. This is not a phone-based role; you won't be making or taking calls, the focus is on research, sourcing and keeping our systems accurate and up to date.



This is a fast-paced role where you will work closely with our recruitment team to build strong, high-quality candidate pipelines.



What You'll Be Doing



Sourcing candidates on LinkedIn Recruiter and job boards against live vacancies

Screening CVs and shortlisting candidates against role criteria

Managing candidate pipelines and keeping our CRM fully up to date

Posting and managing job adverts across our job board accounts

Following up with candidates to keep pipelines moving

Adding new candidates and accurate information to our database

Working closely with the wider recruitment team to build a strong pipeline of quality candidates

Continuously looking for ways to improve the quality of our sourcing and shortlisting

Working towards clear individual and team targets



What We're Looking For



Excellent written English is essential. You will be communicating with candidates directly and keeping records our UK team relies on, so your written communication must be professional, natural and accurate.



We are looking for someone who is:



Proactive, motivated and hard-working

Confident using LinkedIn Recruiter and online job boards

Comfortable working towards daily and weekly targets

Extremely organised with strong attention to detail

Able to work independently and use initiative

Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

A positive team player who wants to contribute to the growth of the business



Previous experience in recruitment, resourcing or candidate sourcing is essential for this role — please only apply if you have hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and/or online job boards.



About the Role



This is not simply a data-entry position. We want someone who can understand what makes a strong candidate for a role and use their own initiative when sourcing and screening.



For example, you might spot that a candidate's experience is a strong match for a live vacancy even though their CV doesn't use the exact same wording, and know to shortlist them and explain why. You will receive full training on our systems and processes, but over time we want you to develop your own judgement and become excellent at identifying high-quality candidates.



Why Join Us?



You will be joining a friendly and ambitious UK team where your work directly contributes to the growth of the company.



We work hard, move quickly and enjoy setting ambitious targets. You'll have plenty of support, but you'll also be encouraged to bring your own ideas, improve how we work and take ownership of your results.



There is plenty of opportunity to develop your skills in recruitment, sourcing and candidate management as the company continues to grow.



SKILL REQUIREMENT: Recruiting, Sourcing, LinkedIn Recruiter, CRM, Candidate Screening

title: Graphic & Multimedia Designer
description:
*About the Role 



We are looking for a talented and versatile Graphic & Multimedia Designer to join our creative team and support the visual needs of a growing digital marketing and web agency. 



This role is ideal for a creative professional who is confident in both graphic design and video editing and understands how strong visual content supports branding, advertising, social media, websites, and overall marketing performance. 



The right candidate should have strong design fundamentals, excellent visual judgment, and hands-on experience creating professional graphics, branded content, social media assets, digital advertisements, short-form videos, promotional videos, and other multimedia materials. 



You should be comfortable working across multiple brands and industries, adapting to different visual styles, following brand guidelines, and producing polished work that is both creative and effective. 



AI tools may be used as part of a modern workflow for brainstorming, research, ideation, or productivity support. However, this role requires genuine design ability, strong creative judgment, originality, and confidence using professional creative software. 



*Key Responsibilities 



Create high-quality visual assets for websites, landing pages, social media, paid advertising,
 campaigns, presentations, and print materials. 



Design graphics for Meta/Facebook ads, Instagram content, Google Display ads, website banners, blog graphics, thumbnails, flyers, brochures, and other marketing collateral. 



Edit and produce short-form and promotional video content for social media, digital ads, websites, and marketing campaigns. 



Create engaging video content for platforms such as Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other digital channels. 



Edit raw video footage into polished, brand-aligned content. 



Add transitions, text overlays, subtitles, captions, music, sound effects, branded elements, and basic motion graphics to video content. 



Resize and reformat videos and graphics for different platforms, placements, screen sizes, and aspect ratios. 



Develop and support brand identity systems, including logos, color palettes, typography selections, visual styles, and brand guidelines. 



Translate creative briefs, campaign goals, and business objectives into visually effective concepts. 



Collaborate with marketing, content, social media, and web development teams to create visuals that support campaign objectives. 



Create original design assets and layouts rather than relying only on templates. 



Maintain consistency across visual assets for different clients and brands. 



Prepare production-ready files for both digital and print use. 



Maintain organized design and video project files using proper naming, storage, and version-control practices. 



Review feedback and make revisions efficiently while maintaining high creative standards. 



Manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment. 



Stay current with graphic design trends, video editing styles, social media creative formats, paid advertising standards, and evolving multimedia tools. 



*Required Qualifications 



Proven experience as a Graphic Designer, Multimedia Designer, Visual Designer, Video Editor, or in a similar creative role. 



Strong portfolio demonstrating professional work across graphic design, branding, digital marketing, social media, advertising, and video editing. 



Strong understanding of design fundamentals, including: 



-Layout 

-Visual hierarchy 

-Typography 

-Color theory 

-Composition 

-Spacing 

-Brand consistency 

-Visual storytelling 



Strong understanding of video editing fundamentals, including: 



-Pacing 

-Story flow 

-Transitions 

-Audio balance 

-Captions and text overlays 

-Basic color correction 

-Video formatting for social platforms 



Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly: 



-Adobe Photoshop 

-Adobe Illustrator 

-Adobe InDesign 



Experience with at least one professional video editing platform, such as: 



Adobe Premiere Pro 

Adobe After Effects 

CapCut 

DaVinci Resolve 

Final Cut Pro 

Similar video editing software 



-Ability to create original visual concepts and assets from scratch. 

-Experience designing for digital marketing campaigns, including Meta/Facebook ads, Instagram graphics, Google Display ads, social media content, and website imagery. 

-Experience editing short-form video content for social media and digital advertising. 

-Ability to follow brand guidelines while adapting creatively across multiple clients and industries. 

-Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished, client-ready work. 

-Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines efficiently. 

-Strong communication and collaboration skills. 

-Ability to receive and apply creative feedback professionally. 



*Preferred Qualifications 



-Experience working in a digital marketing agency, web agency, advertising agency, or creative agency. 

-Experience with Canva for creating editable templates and client-facing assets. 

-Experience with Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar collaborative design tools. 

-Basic understanding of website design, responsive layouts, and UX/UI best practices. 

-Experience developing complete brand identity packages and visual systems. 

-Experience creating social media ad campaigns and landing page graphics. 

-Experience producing video advertisements and promotional videos. 

-Experience with motion graphics and basic animation. 

-Familiarity with Adobe After Effects is a strong plus. 

-Experience adding subtitles, captions, lower thirds, animated text, and branded motion elements. 

-Basic understanding of audio editing and sound selection. 

-Experience creating thumbnails and supporting assets for YouTube or other video platforms. 

-Experience preparing artwork for professional print production. 

-Experience designing for a variety of industries, audiences, and client types. 



*AI Tool Expectations 



We support the responsible use of AI tools as part of a modern creative workflow, but this role is not intended for someone who depends on AI to perform the core creative work. 



AI may be used for: 



-Brainstorming 

-Concept exploration 

-Research 

-Mood boards 

-Script or content ideation 

-Workflow support 

-Productivity assistance 



Final work should demonstrate strong human creative judgment, originality, brand awareness, visual consistency, and professional execution. 



Candidates should be comfortable creating high-quality graphics and multimedia content independently using professional design and editing tools. 



*What We Are Looking For 



We are looking for someone who can: 



-Think creatively while keeping marketing and business goals in mind. 

-Understand the difference between content that simply looks good and content that communicates effectively. 

-Produce visual work that is polished, intentional, professional, and brand-aligned. 

-Edit video content that is engaging, well-paced, and suitable for digital platforms. 

-Balance creativity with speed and production demands. 

-Work independently while collaborating effectively with other team members. 

-Take direction while also contributing original ideas. 

-Adapt their style across multiple brands without making every project look the same. 

-Understand how graphics and video influence marketing performance, engagement, user experience, and brand perception. 

-Maintain strong attention to detail across both static and motion-based creative work. 



*Portfolio Requirement 



-A portfolio is required for consideration. 



We are especially interested in seeing examples of: 



-Brand identity and logo design 

-Social media graphics 

-Paid ad creative 

-Website imagery or landing page design 

-Short-form video editing 

-Social media video content 

-Promotional videos or video advertisements 

-Motion graphics or animated content 

-YouTube thumbnails or video branding 

-Print collateral 

-Before-and-after design improvements 

-Original layouts demonstrating strong typography, spacing, hierarchy, and composition 

-Work showing versatility across different brands, industries, and creative styles 

-Where possible, please include examples that clearly demonstrate your individual contribution. 



*Job Type 

-Full-time



*Schedule 

9:00 PM to 1:00 AM EST

The remaining hours needed to fulfill your 40-hour weekly commitment may be scheduled at your discretion, in alignment with team needs. You are expected to work approximately 8 hours per day.



*Work Tracking Requirements:

-We use Hubstaff for time tracking.



How to Apply 



Please submit the following to 



-Your resume 

-A link to your graphic design and video portfolio 

-A short introduction describing your creative experience 

-The design and video editing tools you use most often 

-The types of design and video projects you enjoy working on most 



We may not consider applications without a portfolio.

description:

We are looking for a sharp, creative Content Strategist & Scriptwriter to join our team and serve as the creative engine behind our media brand.



Our brand sits at the intersection of high-level business/real estate, personal fitness/discipline, and modern family life. We are expanding beyond traditional real estate marketing into an all-encompassing lifestyle network across Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube, and

- Hook-Obsessed: You understand short-form video psychology and know how to use curiosity gaps, bold statements, and visual cues to stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds.

title: Supply Chain Manager - EU experience required
description:
Olvy sells through several European marketplaces, purchases from a fixed base of suppliers in China and works with external fulfilment partners. As the number of countries, channels and partners grows, so does the complexity of the supply chain.



The Supply Chain Manager holds end responsibility for the design and the performance of this chain. The role sets the inventory strategy, safeguards availability and inventory turnover, holds suppliers and fulfilment partners to measurable performance standards, and makes sure the supply chain remains scalable as we expand into new countries and sales channels.



The role carries independent authority, works against clearly defined KPIs, and takes over substantive ownership of the supply chain from the Operations Manager. This creates a single, clear owner for inventory, partner performance and the further development of the chain.



Responsibilities:

1. Inventory and planning

- Setting and maintaining safety stock and coverage targets per product category and per channel, based on demand

variability and actual lead times.

- Setting reorder points and replenishment logic, including MOQ and container constraints.

- Building and monthly updating of the long term forecast with a horizon of at least twelve months, including seasonal

peaks and deal periods.

- Determining the purchase quantity per order, subject to approval by the Operations Manager and, above the agreed

threshold, by finance.

- Monitoring inventory turnover and inventory health, and intervening actively in cases of overstock and slow movers.

- Directing the Supply Chain Coordinator on the weekly replenishment to the fulfilment channels.



2. Network and logistics

- Owning the performance of all fulfilment partners: defining SLAs, measuring them, reporting back monthly and escalating where needed.

- Selecting carriers and negotiating freight rates, covering sea and road freight and, where required, air and rail.

- Monitoring container utilisation and shipment consolidation, against a defined target for freight cost per unit sold.

- Preparing and executing the transition of the fulfilment network towards 2027, with the Operations Manager as decision maker.

- Designing the logistics chain when expanding into a new country or channel: storage, return flows, customs, the import process and VAT registration in cooperation with finance.



3. Supplier performance

- Structurally measuring suppliers on actual lead time, production capacity, delivery reliability and quality deviations.

- Holding periodic performance reviews with the key suppliers, at least quarterly, with recorded commitments and follow up.

- Negotiating prices, payment terms and incoterms with existing suppliers, subject to approval by the Operations Manager.

- Coordinating pre shipment quality inspections and following up on findings.



4. Performance and reporting

- Owning the supply chain KPIs in the internal dashboard: their definition, the reliability of the underlying data and their further improvement.

- Monthly reporting to the management team on availability, forecast accuracy, chain costs and risks, including a concrete proposal wherever there is a deviation.

- Owning escalations towards suppliers and fulfilment partners.

- Documenting and maintaining the working processes in the chain, so that execution does not depend on individuals.







***MUST HAVE/HARD REQUIREMENTS***

1. Five to ten years of supply chain experience, including at least two years with end responsibility for inventory norms or a fulfilment network.

2. Demonstrable experience with imports from Asia into Europe: incoterms, sea freight, container planning, customs and the import process.

3. Demonstrable experience managing external fulfilment partners on the basis of SLAs.

4. Inventory planning at parameter level, not purely executional. Able to explain why a norm is set where it is.

5. Strong analytical ability with data, able to work through large datasets and to question the output of a tool.

6. Experience in e-commerce or marketplace fulfilment.

7. Fluent English, both written and in negotiation.



Nice to have, not required

1. Lean Six Sigma or a comparable process improvement background.

2. Experience with EU product compliance and import regulations.

3. Experience building a supply chain rather than only managing an existing one.

title: Full Time Video Editor - UGC & Voiceover Storyteller for Fast-Growing DTC Brand
description:
Overview



We're a fast-growing headlamp brand, one of the biggest in our category and scaling hard into the US. Most of our buyers are women buying practical gifts for the men in their lives, and our creative is built around that gifting psychology.



⚠ Please read this overview in full before applying.



We're looking for a video editor who can take raw creator footage and turn it into a story that converts. Long-term role. Real growth path if you're an A-player.





Who We Need



Someone who genuinely lives in UGC and voiceover editing. Your real craft has to be storytelling with real people, real reactions, and real moments.



If you can take a folder of raw creator footage and d
 on your own which moments matter, which reactions carry the story, and how to pace it so it feels natural, you're who we need.



If you're stronger with heavy briefs telling you exactly which clip goes where, this role might not be the right fit for you. We'd love you to only apply if UGC storytelling is genuinely your strength.





The Bar We're Setting



- Real UGC editing experience with a portfolio of ads that ran on Meta or TikTok

- Storytelling instinct: you can find the story in raw footage without being told where it is

- Deep understanding of hooks, pacing, and retention for direct response ads

- Fluent TikTok-style captions that look natural, not editor-heavy

- Confident with ElevenLabs voiceovers, choosing natural voices, matching pacing

- Comfortable using AI tools (Higgsfield, Nano Banana) when a shot needs to be generated

- Understanding English well enough to read a script and know what it's really trying to say

- Reliable, communicative, takes feedback well, delivers on time

- 2 finished ads per day, Monday to Friday





What You'll Be Doing



- Editing UGC ads and voiceover ads (this is the core of the role)

- Some founder-style and mashup ads

- Occasional AI-assisted bottom-of-funnel and top-of-funnel work

- Reviewing our top-performing ads to understand why they work

- Working closely with the team on Slack to sharpen output every week





What This Pays



Base: $35 USD per finished ad.



The better the quality of your work, the better the opportunity for higher pay over time. Quality is what we reward here.





Growth Path



The editor who delivers through Q4 becomes a senior editor on the team in 2027. Real progression: more responsibility, higher rates, leadership of newer editors, direct collaboration on creative direction.





How to Apply



Apply through our form here: 



The form takes 10-15 minutes. Every editor we've hired who's done well on our team has filled this form out. It clearly works, so please take the time to show us your best answers and your best work.



If you're a strong fit, we'll come back to you with a paid test brief using real footage from the brand. Land the trial and you're cutting paid work within the week.



Thanks,

Jack

title: Ecommerce Social Media & Creative Specialist
description:
Hello! We are a growing UK women’s ecommerce fashion brand looking for an experienced Ecommerce Social Media & Creative Specialist to take day-to-day ownership of our organic social content while also producing polished Canva creative, curating existing assets and supporting creative research.



This is a hands-on execution role. A large part of the role will involve working with existing assets - selecting the strongest content, adding or adapting text and graphic elements in Canva, recreating supplied creative references, producing variations, resizing assets and turning existing photography/UGC into polished social and ecommerce creative.



You do not need to be an advanced graphic designer or senior social strategist. However, you must have strong visual judgement, excellent Canva skills and ecommerce marketing experience.



What You’ll Own

====================

1. Organic Social Media

- Own the day-to-day content calendar across
, Instagram and TikTok.

- Select the strongest photography, UGC, creator content and finished video to use.

- Create, write, schedule and publish organic posts.

- Adapt and repurpose existing content appropriately for each platform.

- Create Stories, carousels, promotional posts, product-led posts, reviews, polls and other native social content.

- Write and adapt captions, hooks and calls to action.

- Keep our channels consistent, active, current and on-brand.

- Respond to comments and community activity, escalating customer-service issues where needed.

- Spot content that performs particularly well and share useful learnings with the team.



2. Canva & Ecommerce Creative

- Create polished social and ecommerce graphics using Canva or similar tools.

- Add headlines, offers, reviews, prices, CTAs and other graphic elements to existing photography.

- Recreate supplied creative references using our own products, assets and branding.

- Create variations of existing successful creative.

- Produce product posts, Stories, carousels, promotional graphics, testimonial graphics and static Meta ad creative.

- Resize and adapt creative accurately for placements such as 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16.

- Maintain good typography, spacing, hierarchy and brand consistency.



This role is less about inventing complex designs from scratch and more about executing strong ecommerce creative quickly and to a high visual standard.



3. Asset Management & Creative Research

- Keep photography, UGC, creator content and finished creative organised and easy to find.

- Track which assets have already been used and identify strong content that can be repurposed.

- Identify content gaps and flag products lacking suitable photography, UGC, reviews or video.

- Research competitors, Meta Ad Library, Instagram and TikTok for relevant ideas, hooks, layouts and formats.

- Explain why an idea is interesting and how it could apply to our brand rather than simply saving examples.

- Share useful research with the Creative Strategist and founders.



Essential Experience

====================

- Previous professional experience working with an ecommerce/DTC brand or ecommerce clients.

- Experience managing social media for a brand, particularly
 and Instagram.

- Evidence that you have personally created posts, written captions and managed day-to-day social content.

- Strong Canva skills and the ability to produce polished ecommerce creative.

- Strong visual judgement and an understanding of what makes fashion/ecommerce content current and commercially useful.

- Comfortable recreating supplied reference designs accurately rather than needing to invent every concept yourself.

- Strong organisation across content calendars, assets and deadlines.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Able to work independently, follow creative direction and bring suggestions without constant supervision.

- Able to commit to approximately 35 hours per week as your primary role.



Strongly Preferred

====================

- Experience with fashion, apparel, activewear, beauty or another visually led consumer ecommerce brand.

- Experience creating content for a UK, US or Australian audience.

- Experience creating static
/Instagram ad creative.

- Meta Ad Library and creative-research experience.

- Strong Instagram,
 and 
 knowledge.

- Experience with social scheduling tools.

- Pinterest experience and basic Shopify familiarity.

- Basic understanding of ecommerce metrics such as CTR, CPA, CVR and ROAS.



The Person We’re Looking For

====================

- Visually strong: you can recognise which photograph, UGC clip or layout looks best and know when typography, spacing or cropping feels wrong.

- Commercially minded: you care about creative that gets attention and helps sell products, not simply content that looks pretty.

- Strong in Canva: you can recreate references, adapt templates, add polished text elements and produce accurate variations efficiently.

- Proactive and organised: you notice when content is running low, an asset is missing or something could be improved and act before being chased.

- Interested in fashion and ecommerce: you keep up with brands that are producing strong organic and paid-social creative.



How to Apply

====================

Please send:

1) Your CV, clearly highlighting the ecommerce brands or clients you have worked with.

2) Examples of social-media and Canva/ecommerce creative that you personally created, particularly promotional graphics, Stories, carousels, product content or static ads.

3) Name two ecommerce brands whose social or advertising creative you think is particularly strong. What do you like about them?

*** We also recommend creating a Loom video introducing yourself to stand out in the application process ***



Please include the word "alpaca" somewhere in your application so we know you have read the full job description.



Hiring Process

====================

Stage 1: CV, portfolio and relevant experience review.

Stage 2: Short practical assessment if shortlisted.

Stage 3: Video interview.

Final stage: Short paid trial before continuing if we’re all happy.

title: SENIOR BRAND, E-COMMERCE & MARKETING LEAD
description:
SENIOR BRAND, E-COMMERCE & MARKETING LEAD



Company: SUPR Global

Employment: Full-Time | Remote

Level: Senior / Leadership

Markets: Singapore, Malaysia & Asia



ABOUT SUPR



SUPR is a growing performance and lifestyle brand built for people who want more from their everyday performance — from training and sport to recovery and daily life.



We are building beyond individual products. Our goal is to build SUPR into a recognised performance brand across Asia.



As we scale, we are looking for an exceptional Senior Brand, E-Commerce & Marketing Lead who can take ownership of our brand, marketing and commercial growth.



This is not a position for someone who only executes campaigns, posts content or waits for instructions.



We need someone who can think strategically, understand the customer, build the brand, drive revenue, lead a team and execute at a high level.



You will work closely with the Founder/CEO and play a key leadership role in the growth of SUPR.



---



THE ROLE



You will own and oversee SUPR's overall brand, e-commerce, marketing and growth direction across Singapore, Malaysia and other Asian markets.



Your responsibility is not simply to generate awareness.



Your responsibility is to help turn brand attention into customers, customers into repeat customers, and SUPR into a scalable regional business.



You will be expected to develop the strategy, build the roadmap, lead the team, execute campaigns and continuously analyse what is working and what needs to change.



---



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. BRAND STRATEGY & MANAGEMENT



Own and strengthen SUPR's overall brand positioning, identity and direction.



You will:



- Develop and maintain clear brand positioning across products and markets

- Ensure consistent brand messaging, tone and visual direction

- Understand our target customers and what drives their purchasing decisions

- Develop strong product positioning and key selling propositions

- Identify opportunities to differentiate SUPR from competitors

- Lead campaign concepts and brand storytelling

- Ensure every customer touchpoint represents SUPR correctly

- Maintain consistency across website, marketplaces, social media, advertising, packaging, creators and campaigns

- Conduct competitor and market analysis

- Help shape SUPR into a recognisable and desirable performance brand



You should understand the difference between selling products and building a brand.



---



2. E-COMMERCE & REVENUE GROWTH



Take ownership of SUPR's e-commerce performance across:



Shopify

TikTok Shop

Shopee

Lazada

Future marketplaces and regional channels



You will:



- Develop strategies to increase online revenue

- Improve conversion rates

- Improve average order value (AOV)

- Develop bundles, upsells and cross-sells

- Optimise product pages and landing pages

- Improve merchandising and product positioning

- Plan marketplace campaigns and promotions

- Analyse customer purchasing behaviour

- Identify drop-off points in the customer journey

- Work on retention and repeat purchase strategies

- Improve the overall online customer experience

- Identify new sales channels and growth opportunities



You should understand how brand, creative, advertising, pricing, promotions and customer experience work together to generate revenue.



---



3. MARKETING & GROWTH STRATEGY



Develop and own SUPR's overall marketing and growth strategy.



You will:



- Build monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans

- Create a structured marketing calendar months ahead

- Develop customer acquisition and retention strategies

- Plan product launches and promotional campaigns

- Identify new growth opportunities

- Develop strategies for new market expansion

- Define marketing KPIs and targets

- Allocate marketing resources based on business priorities

- Analyse campaign performance and recommend improvements

- Continuously test new channels, offers, messaging and audiences



We expect you to think beyond today's tasks.



You should know what the marketing team needs to be doing this week, next month and next quarter.



---



4. PERFORMANCE MARKETING



You should have a strong understanding of performance marketing, including:



- Meta Ads

- TikTok Ads

- Retargeting

- Paid social

- Creative testing

- Audience testing

- Landing page testing

- Conversion optimisation

- Campaign scaling



You do not necessarily need to personally operate every campaign forever, but you must understand performance marketing well enough to lead, evaluate and challenge the people responsible for it.



You should be comfortable analysing:



ROAS

CAC

CPA

CTR

CPC

CPM

Conversion Rate

AOV

LTV

Retention

Repeat Purchase Rate



You should be able to identify why performance is improving or declining and determine what the team should test next.



---



5. CAMPAIGN & PRODUCT LAUNCH MANAGEMENT



Own campaigns from idea to execution.



You will:



- Develop campaign concepts

- Build campaign timelines

- Coordinate product launches

- Plan promotional strategies

- Define offers and messaging

- Coordinate creative production

- Coordinate paid advertising

- Coordinate influencer and creator activation

- Coordinate e-commerce execution

- Ensure campaigns launch on time

- Monitor performance during campaigns

- Conduct post-campaign analysis



Every major campaign should have a clear objective, audience, strategy, timeline, owner, KPI and expected outcome.



---



6. CONTENT & CREATIVE DIRECTION



You will work closely with designers, video editors, content creators and external partners.



You should be able to:



- Develop strong creative directions

- Write clear creative briefs

- Identify strong hooks and marketing angles

- Understand what content performs across different platforms

- Evaluate creative quality

- Provide useful feedback to designers and editors

- Develop content pillars

- Balance brand-building content with conversion-focused content

- Identify trends without blindly following them

- Turn customer insights into creative concepts



You don't need to personally design everything.



But you must know what good creative looks like and why it works.



---



7. CREATOR, INFLUENCER & AFFILIATE MARKETING



Develop and scale SUPR's creator ecosystem.



This includes:



- Influencer partnerships

- Athlete partnerships

- UGC creators

- Product seeding

- Affiliate programs

- TikTok affiliates

- Brand ambassadors



You will:



- Identify suitable creators

- Develop creator strategies

- Build scalable outreach systems

- Structure affiliate campaigns

- Track creator performance

- Identify high-performing UGC

- Turn successful organic content into paid advertising opportunities

- Build long-term relationships with creators who genuinely fit SUPR



---



8. CUSTOMER RETENTION & CRM



Growth doesn't stop after the first purchase.



You will develop strategies around:



-
 marketing

- Customer segmentation

- Repeat purchases

- Product replenishment

- Customer lifecycle campaigns

- Abandoned carts

- Win-back campaigns

- Loyalty and community

- Cross-selling

- Customer feedback



Your objective is to increase customer lifetime value, not simply acquire more first-time customers.



---



9. TEAM LEADERSHIP & MANAGEMENT



This is a major part of the position.



You will lead and manage members across marketing, creative, content, e-commerce and other growth functions.



You will be expected to:



- Establish clear roles and responsibilities

- Set priorities and deadlines

- Assign ownership for projects

- Set KPIs

- Monitor team performance

- Conduct regular marketing and growth meetings

- Review progress and deliverables

- Hold team members accountable

- Identify blockers early

- Resolve execution problems

- Coach and develop team members

- Improve communication between departments

- Recruit or recommend additional talent when necessary

- Build efficient workflows and SOPs

- Ensure projects move forward without constant Founder/CEO intervention



The Founder should not need to constantly chase the marketing team for updates.



You should be capable of running the department, creating structure and making sure things get done.



---



10. REPORTING, ANALYTICS & FORECASTING



You will provide clear visibility into marketing and e-commerce performance.



You should be able to produce and explain:



- Weekly performance reports

- Monthly marketing reports

- Revenue performance

- Campaign performance

- Advertising performance

- Customer acquisition costs

- Channel performance

- E-commerce conversion

- Marketing spend

- Growth forecasts

- Upcoming campaigns and priorities



We don't want reports filled with numbers without meaning.



We want someone who can explain:



What happened?

Why did it happen?

What are we doing next?



---



ASIA & SINGAPORE MARKET EXPERIENCE



SUPR is building from Singapore with ambitions across Asia.



Therefore, previous experience working with Asian markets is highly advantageous.



Experience specifically within Singapore and/or Malaysia is a strong plus.



You should ideally understand:



- Singapore consumer behaviour

- Southeast Asian e-commerce

- TikTok Shop

- Shopee

- Lazada

- Regional purchasing behaviour

- Local promotional periods

- Regional creator/influencer ecosystems

- Mobile-first commerce

- Differences between Western and Asian consumer marketing



Candidates who have successfully grown brands within Singapore, Malaysia or Southeast Asia will have a strong advantage.



---



REQUIREMENTS



We are looking for someone with:



- 5+ years of strong experience in marketing, brand, growth or e-commerce

- Previous experience in a senior or leadership position

- Proven experience managing a marketing or growth team

- Strong e-commerce experience

- Strong understanding of Shopify

- Experience with TikTok Shop, Shopee and/or Lazada is highly advantageous

- Strong understanding of Meta and TikTok advertising

- Experience developing and executing marketing strategies

- Strong brand-building ability

- Strong understanding of DTC/customer acquisition

- Experience managing product launches

- Experience with creators, influencers and affiliates

- Strong analytical and commercial thinking

- Excellent project management

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

- Ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment

- High level of ownership and accountability



Experience within sports, fitness, performance, wellness, nutrition, lifestyle, consumer products or DTC brands is highly advantageous.



---



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE



You are strategic, but you can execute.



You understand branding, but you also understand numbers.



You understand creative, but you also understand conversion.



You can manage people without needing someone else to manage you.



When something isn't working, you don't simply report the problem — you investigate it and propose what we should do next.



When sales decline, you want to understand why.



When a campaign performs well, you want to understand how to scale it.



When competitors move, you notice.



When there is an opportunity, you act.



You are comfortable working in a startup environment where things move quickly and priorities evolve.



Most importantly, you take ownership.



---



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



- You need constant instructions before taking action

- Your experience is mainly social media posting

- You cannot confidently manage a team

- You struggle with deadlines and accountability

- You focus mainly on followers, likes and impressions instead of business outcomes

- You cannot understand marketing numbers

- You prefer maintaining existing systems rather than building and improving them

- You wait for management to identify every problem

- You are uncomfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment



We are not hiring someone simply to manage marketing tasks.



We are hiring someone to help build the company.



---



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Success means SUPR has:



A stronger and more recognisable brand.



A structured marketing engine.



Growing e-commerce revenue.



Profitable and scalable customer acquisition.



Better customer retention.



Successful product launches.



A clear marketing calendar.



Strong creative output.



A high-performing team.



Clear reporting and accountability.



And most importantly, a marketing department that can operate and grow without the Founder having to manage every detail.



---



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



1. Your CV/resume

2. Portfolio or examples of brands you have worked with

3. Examples of campaigns you personally led

4. Actual measurable results you achieved

5. Examples of e-commerce businesses you helped grow

6. Team size and roles you previously managed

7. Platforms and advertising channels you have experience with

8. Experience working with Singapore, Malaysia or other Asian markets

9. Your expected monthly salary

10. Your availability/start date



Where possible, provide actual numbers such as:



Revenue growth

ROAS improvement

CAC reduction

Conversion improvement

E-commerce growth

Campaign revenue

Customer growth



Generic statements such as "I helped grow social media" will not be sufficient.



We want to understand what you personally did and what changed because of your work.



THE OPPORTUNITY



This is an opportunity to join SUPR at an early growth stage and play a major role in shaping where the brand goes next.



For the right person, this is more than another marketing job.



We are looking for someone who can become a key leader within SUPR and help build the brand across Asia.



BE SUPR.

.
