Experience with influencer outreach, affiliate marketing, TikTok Shop, Shopify, Amazon, or e-commerce brands is an advantage. You do not need years of influencer management experience if you can demonstrate strong communication, organization, and analytical skills.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

title: PR & Communications Executive
description:
Hi there!



I run a small communications consultancy working with corporate and consumer brands, and I’m looking for an experienced **PR & Communications Executive** to work alongside me across client projects.



This is a hands-on role covering communications, content and project management. I’m looking for someone who already has PR or communications experience, ideally within an agency or in-house communications team, so this isn’t a role where I’ll be teaching the basics from scratch.



You don’t need to be senior, but you do need to understand the work. If I give you a client brief, background documents or even a slightly chaotic set of notes, I’d like you to be able to make sense of them, do the research, ask the right questions and get a strong first draft moving.



**Working hours: 2–10 PM Manila time, Monday–Friday**



You’ll need to be consistently available during these hours as you’ll be working alongside me on active client projects.



### What You’ll Help Me With



**PR & Content**



* Drafting press releases, LinkedIn posts, internal communications, articles and other content

* Researching topics, companies, industries, media and potential story angles

* Turning briefs, notes and background materials into strong first drafts

* Proofreading and editing content

* Preparing briefing documents and other communications materials

* Supporting media relations activity and coordinating with external partners where needed



**Project Management**



* Keeping track of multiple client projects, deadlines and deliverables

* Maintaining project trackers and content calendars

* Following up on outstanding actions, feedback and approvals

* Keeping briefs, files and working documents organised

* Helping coordinate designers, suppliers and other partners

* Spotting what needs to happen next and helping keep projects moving



**Presentations & General Support**



* Creating and polishing PowerPoint and Canva presentations

* Supporting research and new-business proposals

* Helping prepare reports, meeting notes and other client materials

* General communications and project support when needed



### You’ll Do Well in This Role If You:



* Have at least 2 years of hands-on PR, communications, content or agency experience

* Have excellent written and spoken English

* Can write clear, natural copy and adapt your writing for different audiences

* Understand how press releases, corporate communications and social content work

* Are highly organised and comfortable managing several deadlines at once

* Have strong attention to detail

* Can work independently and use good judgement

* Ask questions when something isn’t clear

* Take initiative rather than waiting to be told every individual step

* Are reliable and follow through on what you say you’ll do



You should also be comfortable using AI tools. I use them myself, so I have no problem with AI being part of your workflow. But I do need someone who can think, research, write and edit independently rather than simply submitting AI-generated copy.



### Bonus Points



* PR agency experience

* Corporate communications experience

* Experience working with international brands

* Media relations experience

* Strong PowerPoint or Canva skills

* Experience managing multiple client accounts or projects



### What You Can Expect



* Direct and supportive collaboration

* Interesting work across different clients and industries

* The opportunity to take on more ownership as we build trust

* Steady, long-term work with room to grow

* Competitive pay based on experience



I’m hoping to find someone who can become a genuine long-term support to the business. Over time, I’d like to be able to hand over increasingly substantial pieces of work and trust you to get them moving.



### How to Apply



Please send:



* A short introduction telling me about your PR/communications experience

* Your CV or LinkedIn profile

* 2–3 examples of content you have personally written, ideally including a press release or corporate communications piece

* Your expected monthly salary in USD

* Confirmation that you can consistently work **2–10 PM Manila time, Monday–Friday**



Please use this exact subject line:



**“Green + [your expected monthly salary in USD] + [Your Name]”**



Example: **“Green + $500 + Ana Dela Cruz”**



And finally, tell me briefly about a time you were given an unclear or incomplete communications brief. How did you approach it and what did you do next?



Please write this part in your own words. I’m much more interested in how you think than in a perfectly polished answer.

title: Executive Assistant & Founder Support VA - Full-Time
description:
THIS IS NOT A BASIC "DO WHATEVER I SEND YOU" VA JOB.



The $2 Bill Brand helps entrepreneurs, coaches, consultants, and experts become the recognized authority in their industry. Our founder, Brad Holcman, is building a business around a simple but powerful idea:



Do not be the best. Be the ONLY.



Brad has a lot of ideas, opportunities, commitments, projects, and responsibilities moving at once. He needs someone who is naturally organized and genuinely enjoys turning a messy stream of tasks, voice notes, meetings, and reminders into a calm, visible plan.



You will work directly with Brad as his Executive Assistant and Founder Support VA. Your job is to help make sure important business and personal commitments do not disappear, priorities are clear, follow-ups happen, the calendar supports what matters, and Brad knows what deserves his attention today.



This is a full-time, long-term role for someone who is hungry to learn, takes ownership, communicates clearly, and wants to become an indispensable right hand over time.



THE BASICS

Type of work: Full time, 40 hours per week

Pay: $500 USD per month

Start date: As soon as the right person is found

Location: Philippines

English level: Fluent / Advanced

Experience level: Intermediate to Advanced

Schedule: Full-time remote. Required weekday overlap of 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time. Remaining hours are flexible around agreed deliverables.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. Run the founder's daily operating system

You will collect tasks and ideas from messages, meetings, voice notes,
, and conversations. You will put them into one organized task system, clarify deadlines and next actions, and keep a close eye on what is due, stuck, or forgotten.



Each workday, you will prepare a short founder brief with the day's highest priorities, calendar, deadlines, follow-ups, and decisions needed. At the end of the day, you will close loops and prepare the next day so nothing important is lost.



2. Protect the calendar and inbox

You will help organize Brad's Google Calendar, schedule and reschedule meetings, add preparation details, protect focused work time, avoid conflicts, and make sure important meetings have the right information attached.



You will help organize
 and messages under agreed rules. You will flag urgent items, draft simple replies when appropriate, track waiting-on responses, and make sure people are not left without an answer. You will never send sensitive communications or make commitments without clear approval rules.



3. Keep business projects and follow-ups moving

You will track important priorities across our content, marketing, coaching, client, and team work. You will follow up with people, maintain simple status views, convert meeting notes into next actions, and alert Brad early when something needs a decision or is at risk of slipping.



You are not expected to do every specialized job in the company. Your responsibility is to make sure requests, deadlines, and decisions do not get lost.



4. Support approved personal logistics

With clear privacy boundaries, you may help research and coordinate personal appointments, travel options, family-calendar reminders, gifting, reservations, orders and returns, and other practical logistics that protect Brad's time. You will always ask before making purchases, sharing sensitive information, or doing anything outside pre-approved rules.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 days: You create one clean task/follow-up system, learn Brad's preferences, establish the daily brief, improve calendar habits, and begin reliably capturing actions from meetings and messages.



Days 31-60: You run a consistent weekly priority review, keep a forward-looking calendar view, track key projects, and proactively close routine communication loops.



Days 61-90: Brad trusts the system. He knows his priorities, important commitments are anticipated, and business and personal logistics are more organized with fewer reminders coming from him.



WHO WILL DO WELL HERE

You have at least one year of meaningful administrative, executive-support, operations-support, or project-coordination experience. You may have supported a founder, manager, small business owner, agency owner, or executive.



You do not need to have been a Chief of Staff. But you must be able to explain the system you personally used to stay organized.



You have excellent written and spoken English. You are highly reliable, calm under pressure, discreet, detail-oriented, comfortable using Google Workspace, and not afraid to ask a clear question when the next step is ambiguous.



Experience with Google Calendar, Gmail, Google Drive, ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Trello, Slack, WhatsApp, Zoom, travel research, and AI productivity tools is helpful. Strong judgment, follow-through, and communication matter more than knowing every tool.



SKILLS THAT MATTER FOR THIS ROLE

Executive assistance, administrative support, calendar management,
 management, task management, project coordination, personal assistance, Google Workspace, Google Calendar, Gmail, meeting management, online research, documentation, written English, problem solving, ClickUp, Asana, Notion, travel planning, AI productivity tools.

Do not apply if you cannot reliably work the required Eastern-Time overlap, have unstable internet without a backup plan, or are uncomfortable handling confidential business and personal information with maturity.

I am the Operating System.



Applications without that phrase will not be considered.

s. What do you do first, and what does your end-of-day update look like?

Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid US$20 practical exercise involving a fictional task dump and calendar. We will evaluate how you prioritize, ask questions, organize follow-ups, and communicate, not how fancy your design is.

You will work directly with a founder who cares about growth, creativity, and building something that stands out. This is an opportunity to become a trusted part of a small, ambitious business and grow in responsibility as you prove yourself.

title: Growth Marketing & Social Media Strategist - Meta Ads, Email & Funnels
description:
WE DO NOT NEED ANOTHER SOCIAL-MEDIA POSTER.



We need the person who knows what we should test next.



The $2 Bill Brand helps entrepreneurs, coaches, consultants, and experts become impossible to compare by becoming the ONLY choice in their space. Our founder, Brad Holcman, brings a Hollywood-trained storytelling and positioning perspective to personal brands and businesses.



We already have a team member who can produce and distribute content, and a GoHighLevel technical specialist who can build pages, funnels, automations, and related assets.



What we need now is a sharp, hands-on marketing strategist who can connect the dots between our offers, content, paid advertising, lead magnets,
 list, funnels, and actual results.



This is a fractional strategy and performance role. At 10 hours per week, your job is to create clarity, prioritize the highest-leverage actions, manage or improve a limited number of important marketing tests, and direct our existing execution support.



THE BASICS

Type of work: Part time, 10 hours per week

Pay: $500 USD per month

Start date: As soon as the right person is found

Location: Philippines

English level: Fluent / Advanced

Experience level: Expert. Four or more years hands-on.

Schedule: 10 hours weekly, including one weekly strategy call and one weekly execution and measurement call during mutually agreed U.S. Eastern-Time hours. Remaining hours are flexible.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



1. One clear growth plan and scorecard

You will audit our existing channels and customer journey, identify the largest growth constraints, and create a practical 90-day plan.



You will define what we should measure, where the data is unreliable, what needs to be fixed first, and what we should stop wasting time on.



Each week, you will provide a simple scorecard showing the most relevant information available: content performance, paid-media activity and spend, traffic, lead generation, funnel conversion signals,
 and list growth, and the next action we are taking.



You will explain what changed and why in plain English.



2. Paid-media strategy and focused optimization

You have hands-on Meta Ads experience and understand campaign structure, audiences, retargeting, creative testing, landing-page alignment, budget pacing, Meta Pixel and Conversions API concepts, and conversion-event quality.



You will not be expected to run unlimited campaigns or manage large budgets from day one. You will help us d
 what one or two paid-growth efforts are worth testing, set up or review the strategy, identify the right measurement, optimize what is live, and tell the team what should happen next.



3. Organic content and social-media strategy

You will build a strategic view of our founder-led content across YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok,
, and
.



You will recommend content pillars, formats, calls to action, distribution priorities, and posting rhythm based on the goal of each piece of content.



Our content VA handles most publishing and distribution. You will supply the why: whom we are speaking to, what message we need to test, which format and channel makes sense, what call to action belongs with it, and what signal tells us it worked.



4.
 list, lead magnets, and funnel strategy

You will recommend the highest-leverage ways to grow the
 list, improve lead magnets, strengthen welcome and nurture sequences, and move people from content or ads into the right next step.



You will create clear briefs for our GoHighLevel technical specialist. You are not expected to personally build every page or automation at this budget. You are expected to know what should be built, why, and how success should be measured.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 days: A concise audit, a measurement and tracking checklist, a 90-day priority plan, a first scorecard, one lead-magnet or funnel recommendation, and a focused paid and organic test plan.



Days 31-60: Weekly scorecards, clearer content priorities, one or two well-defined paid or funnel tests, and implementation briefs that the team can execute.



Days 61-90: A documented learning system. What is working, what is not, what should be scaled or stopped, and the next most valuable test.



WHO WILL DO WELL HERE

You have at least four years of hands-on experience in growth marketing, paid social, performance marketing, funnel strategy,
 marketing, or a closely related role. Four years is the floor, not a suggestion. If you have two, this is not your role yet.



You have personally worked in Meta Ads Manager and can show that you understand more than posting boosts or reporting likes.



You understand how content, ads, lead magnets, landing pages, forms, CRM handoffs,
 sequences, and tracking should work together.



You have used GoHighLevel, 
, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, ClickFunnels, Webflow, or comparable tools. You know how to use Google Analytics and UTM tags, and you recognize when the data is insufficient to make a confident optimization decision.



You write excellent English, are commercially minded, bring recommendations rather than vague opinions, and can coordinate with a small team without turning strategy into a complicated document no one uses.



SKILLS THAT MATTER FOR THIS ROLE

Growth marketing, marketing strategy, Meta Ads,
 Ads, Instagram Ads, paid social, social media strategy, content strategy,
 marketing, lead generation, funnel strategy, GoHighLevel, CRM, landing pages, conversion rate optimization, Google Analytics, UTM tracking, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, retargeting, A/B testing, copywriting.



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF

Do not apply if your experience is only scheduling social-media posts or designing Canva graphics. We already have publishing support.



Do not apply if you expect to be paid to make a generic strategy deck and then disappear. We need someone who will help turn the strategy into a weekly operating rhythm.



At 10 hours per week, this is also not a request for you to edit every video, create every design, publish daily across every channel, build all technical funnels, write every
, or manage an unlimited number of ad campaigns.



The scope is strategic direction, focused performance work, and excellent coordination with our existing execution team.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with this exact phrase:



ONLY growth is measurable.



Applications without that phrase will not be considered.



Please include ALL of the following:



1. Your resume or OnlineJobs profile and a clear statement of your actual role in each campaign or client result.



2. A two-to-three-minute Loom or video introduction explaining one paid campaign, funnel, or
-growth project you personally improved.



3. One short case study that states the starting problem, your actions, the spend range if paid media was involved, the tracking approach, the result, and what you learned. Anonymized screenshots are welcome. Do not disclose confidential client information.



4. Your answer: What is the largest monthly Meta Ads budget you have personally managed, and what conversion event did you optimize for?



5. In 250 words or fewer, visit 
 and share one audience, offer, content, or funnel hypothesis you would test first. This is how we evaluate your thinking.



6. Your hourly rate, confirmation you can work 10 hours weekly with two Eastern-Time calls, the CRM, funnel, and
 tools you have used hands-on, and two references.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid US$30 practical exercise. We will provide a fictional campaign snapshot and a short funnel description. In 45 minutes, you will tell us what data you need, what you would investigate first, what two tests you would prioritize, and how you would measure the outcome.



WHY JOIN US

You will have real influence on the growth of a distinctive founder-led brand, but you will not be expected to do everything alone.



You will work directly with Brad and coordinate with the content and GoHighLevel execution team. If you prove you can create measurable progress, this role can expand over time.

title: Creative Strategist (Remote)
description:
We are a fast-growing DTC brand ready to take the next steps in our growth, and we need your help to get there.



Are you an experienced Creative Strategist who understands what makes people stop scrolling, keep watching, and ultimately buy? Do you know how to turn performance data and customer insights into strong concepts, hooks, scripts, and creative briefs? Then we would love to hear from you.



What will you do?



• Develop new creative concepts, angles, and hooks.

• Create detailed briefs for UGC creators, editors, and designers.

• Analyze ad performance and turn insights into new creative tests.

• Research our target audience, competitors, and relevant trends.

• Develop new variations based on winning ads.

• Write scripts and improve existing ones.

• Collaborate closely with our media buying and content teams.

• Ensure that all creatives align with our brand identity and commercial goals.



Who are we looking for?



• You have at least two years of experience as a Creative Strategist, preferably for DTC or e-commerce brands.

• You have proven experience creating performance ads for Meta.

• You understand direct response marketing and know what makes an ad convert.

• You can interpret advertising data and translate it into clear next steps.

• You know how to write strong hooks, scripts, and creative briefs.

• You are proactive, independent, and consistently bring new ideas to the table.

• You communicate clearly and meet deadlines.

• You speak and write English fluently.

• You have your own laptop and a stable internet connection.



What do we offer?



• A fully remote position.

• Plenty of creative freedom and space to test your ideas.

• A direct impact on the growth of an ambitious DTC brand.

• A fast-paced environment where great ideas are quickly put into action.

• The opportunity to work with experienced marketers, creators, and editors.

• Room to grow alongside the brand.

• Flexible working hours and compensation based on your experience.

• A competitive salary with performance-based bonuses.



Interested?



Send us a short introduction about yourself, your relevant experience, and examples of ads, briefs, or concepts you have worked on. Please also include your availability and expected compensation.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Shopify Ecommerce Inventory & Merchandising Specialist
description:
Full-Time | Remote | US$280 per Week | Australian Business Hours



We’re hiring an experienced Shopify Ecommerce Inventory & Merchandising Specialist to support the Australian and New Zealand ecommerce operations of a leading global headwear and lifestyle brand.



This is a hands-on ecommerce operations role for someone who is equally comfortable working with Shopify, inventory data, Excel and product merchandising as they are communicating clearly with a remote team.



We are specifically looking for someone who can:



- Investigate inventory discrepancies rather than simply report them

- Work confidently with large product and stock datasets

- Maintain accurate Shopify product and merchandising information

- Identify stock risks before they become customer or operational issues

- Communicate problems, findings and next steps clearly

- Take ownership of issues and follow them through to resolution



This is not a customer service role, general virtual assistant position or basic Shopify data-entry role.



You’ll report to the Head of Digital AU & NZ and collaborate closely with Ecommerce, Planning, Marketing and Operations.



Compensation and Schedule

Pay: US$280 per week

Payment: Weekly

Hours: 40 hours per week

Schedule: Monday to Friday, aligned with Australian business hours

Location: Fully remote

Engagement: Full-time, long-term opportunity



The advertised rate is fixed. Please only apply if you are comfortable with the compensation and schedule.



Key Responsibilities

Ecommerce Inventory Management

- You will be expected to work directly with inventory data and help maintain accurate stock information across the ecommerce business.



Responsibilities include:

- Maintain and monitor accurate stock-on-hand information in Shopify

- Assist with inventory reconciliation between Shopify and SAP

- Investigate discrepancies between systems and identify the likely cause

- Monitor sell-through, weeks of cover, aged stock, out-of-stocks and overstock risks

- Maintain recurring inventory health and exception reports

- Support replenishment and back-in-stock processes

- Identify unusual stock movements or data inconsistencies

- Escalate inventory risks clearly and early

- Follow inventory issues through until they are resolved



We need someone who can look at inventory data, recognise when something does not make sense, investigate why, and communicate what needs to happen next.



Shopify Product Management

- Create, enrich and maintain Shopify product listings

- Maintain descriptions, imagery, specifications, tags, metafields and categorisation

- Assign products to the correct collections

- Maintain accurate filters, navigation and collection structures

- Conduct regular checks for missing, incorrect or outdated product information

- Troubleshoot product-data and website-display issues

- Support new product launches, seasonal updates and promotional activity

- Ensure product information remains accurate as inventory and ranges change



Reporting and Analysis

- Produce recurring inventory and merchandising reports

- Report on stock on hand, out-of-stocks, aged inventory and sell-through

- Support weekly and monthly ecommerce trading reports

- Analyse large datasets and identify exceptions or unusual results

- Highlight stock risks, opportunities and data-quality issues

- Turn raw data into clear and practical recommendations

- Help improve or automate recurring Shopify and SAP reports



Site Merchandising

- Manage Shopify collections and product sequencing

- Maintain collection sorting based on stock availability and trading priorities

- Identify and fix broken collections, incorrect links and miscategorised products

- Ensure unavailable or low-stock products are appropriately merchandised

- Support basic website updates where required



A dedicated local team member manages most content execution, so advanced graphic design or content-production experience is not required.



Essential Experience



To be considered, you must have demonstrated experience in both Shopify ecommerce operations and inventory management.



You must have:

- Strong, hands-on Shopify administration experience

- Practical ecommerce inventory or stock-management experience

- Experience investigating and resolving inventory discrepancies

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Confidence working with large product and inventory datasets

- Experience creating, enriching and maintaining ecommerce product listings

- Experience with Shopify collections, tags, metafields and product categorisation

- Understanding of stock availability, sell-through, out-of-stocks and inventory health

- Strong written and spoken English

- Excellent attention to detail

- Strong problem-solving skills

- Full-time availability during Australian business hours



Customer service experience alone will not be sufficient for this position.



Excel Skills

You should be comfortable using Excel or Google Sheets for inventory analysis rather than basic data entry.

We are particularly interested in candidates who regularly use tools such as:

- XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP

- INDEX/MATCH

- SUMIFS and COUNTIFS

- IF statements

- PivotTables

- Filters and sorting

- Conditional formatting

- Data cleaning and reconciliation

- Large CSV or product-data exports

- SAP / ERP Experience



SAP experience is highly regarded but is not mandatory.



Strong Shopify and inventory capability is more important. The successful candidate can be trained in the company's SAP processes.



Experience with another ERP, inventory-management or warehouse system is also valuable.



Highly Regarded

- Fashion, apparel, footwear, accessories or lifestyle-brand experience

- Multi-channel ecommerce inventory experience

- Shopify Plus experience

- Advanced Shopify metafields

- ERP or inventory-management systems

- Reporting automation

- Power BI or other data-visualisation tools

- Ecommerce trading or merchandising experience

- Product launches and promotional trading support

- The Working Style We Need



Technical skills alone will not be enough for this role.



Because this is a remote position, you must be a clear, proactive and dependable communicator.



We are looking for someone who:

- Gives clear and concise updates

- Raises problems early rather than waiting to be asked

- Explains what they found when investigating an issue

- Confirms next steps and follows through

- Asks sensible questions when information is unclear

- Works methodically and consistently

- Takes accountability for their work

- Can manage recurring responsibilities without constant reminders

- Communicates professionally with different teams



If you discover an inventory discrepancy, we do not want someone who simply reports that the numbers do not match.



We want someone who will investigate the issue, explain what they checked, identify the likely cause, recommend the next action and follow it through to resolution.



What Success Looks Like



Within your first three months, you should be able to:

- Establish a reliable inventory-monitoring routine

- Independently investigate common inventory discrepancies

- Maintain consistently accurate Shopify product information

- Deliver inventory and merchandising reports correctly and on time

- Identify and communicate stock risks before they become larger issues

- Execute product launches and merchandising updates accurately

- Provide clear updates without requiring repeated follow-up

- Build trust with the team through accuracy, communication and ownership



How to Apply



Applications that do not complete all screening questions will not be considered.



Please answer the following:



1. Please attach your most updated CV.



2. Tell us about your hands-on Shopify experience.

What Shopify tasks have you personally managed, particularly across product listings, collections, tags, metafields, merchandising and inventory?



3. Describe one specific inventory discrepancy you personally identified and resolved.

What was the issue, how did you identify it, what did you investigate, what caused it, and how did you resolve it?



4. What inventory reporting and analysis have you personally handled?

Please include the inventory metrics you have worked with (such as stock on hand, sell-through, weeks of cover, aged stock, out-of-stocks or overstock) and the Excel/Google Sheets formulas or tools you regularly use.



5. Scenario: You discover that the stock quantity in Shopify does not match the ERP or inventory report. Talk us through exactly what you would do from the moment you identify the discrepancy until it is resolved. How and when would you communicate the issue to your manager or team?



Please also confirm in your application that you are available to work 40 hours per week during Australian business hours and are comfortable with the fixed rate of US$280 per week, paid weekly.



Applications with incomplete or generic answers will not progress to the next stage.

title: Shopify Junior Manager
description:
Shopify Store Localization Specialist & Web Designer



Full-Time Remote | $500 USD/Month Starting Salary | Fox Ecom LLC



About Us



Fox Ecom LLC is a US company growing an international e-commerce business in men’s hair care. Our brand, Depura, launched in Italy, and we are now expanding into markets worldwide.



We are looking for someone who can transform our existing Shopify store into a fully localized, launch-ready store for each new market. You will handle translation, visual assets, design adjustments, store configuration, app setup, testing, and final quality checks.



This position starts at junior-level compensation, with the opportunity to progress into a senior role over the coming months based on your performance, independence, and ability to take on greater responsibility.



Your Main Responsibility



Complete one fully localized, launch-ready Shopify store per working day, using our existing store, established design, and supplied assets as your starting point.



You will deliver a finished store that does not require our executives or another team member to complete the setup, correct avoidable mistakes, or finish outstanding work.



What You Will Do



1. Translate and Localize the Entire Store



Translate product descriptions, headlines, buttons, banners, FAQs, announcements, forms, and all other customer-facing content.

Use DeepL, supported by AI tools and careful proofreading, to produce natural translations that preserve the original meaning and marketing message.

Maintain consistent terminology, product names, tone, formatting, and brand identity.

Localize customer
s, order notifications, and app-generated content, checking the complete shopping journey for untranslated text.



2. Translate and Adapt Images Using AI



Use AI image-generation and editing tools to localize infographics, promotional graphics, badges, product packaging text, and other visual assets.

Preserve the original composition, colors, branding, product appearance, and design quality.

Ensure translated text is accurate, sharp, readable, and correctly positioned, including text on bottles and packaging.

Correct distorted letters, visual artifacts, and layout problems. Prepare images in suitable dimensions and formats, balancing quality with loading speed.



3. Configure Shopify for Each Market



Set up and verify products, collections, variants, pricing, currencies, product handles, and internal links.

Configure markets, languages, domains, shipping zones, shipping rates, delivery information, payment methods, and checkout settings.

Apply company-provided requirements for taxes, duties, and other market-specific settings.

Build and check navigation menus, footer links, contact pages, and customer support details.

Adapt shipping, returns, refunds, privacy, terms, and guarantee pages using approved company policies and business information.

Localize page titles, meta descriptions, and image alt text where applicable.



4. Configure and Localize Shopify Apps



Kaching: Configure bundles, quantity discounts, and promotional offers. Translate customer-facing text and verify product selection, pricing, and discount behavior across product pages, the cart, and checkout.

Track123: Configure and localize the order-tracking page, tracking messages, and available notifications. Add tracking links to navigation and the footer, and test the customer experience.


: Configure and localize review widgets, star-rating badges, review forms, and review-request
s. Translate reviews faithfully, prepare and validate import CSVs, map reviews to the correct destination-store products, and resolve import or display errors.

Other apps: Configure and localize any additional tools used for upsells, cart functionality,
 marketing, customer support, or other store features.

Check app integrations, language, currency display, and appearance on desktop and mobile. Identify required subscriptions or access early.



5. Test and Deliver the Finished Store



Review the entire store on desktop and mobile, checking typography, spacing, image quality, and responsive behavior.

Test menus, links, product options, variants, add-to-cart, bundles, discounts, shipping calculations, tracking, and checkout.

Verify payment configuration and complete a test purchase using the appropriate test setup.

Submit a concise handover with the store link, completed checks, and any outstanding issues.

What “Completed” Means



A store is complete when all required content and images are localized, Shopify settings are correct, required apps are configured, and the shopping journey has been tested successfully. There should be no unfinished sections, broken links, incorrect product associations, or unresolved issues that prevent launch.



You must identify missing information or access early, clearly request what you need, and follow each issue through to resolution. We expect independent execution without constant reminders or supervision.



Salary, Schedule and Daily Target



Starting salary: $500 USD per month. Schedule: eight scheduled working hours per day, five days per week. Daily target: one completed, quality-checked Shopify store.



Once your assigned store meets all completion criteria and you submit your handover, you may finish your working day, even if you have worked fewer than eight hours.



If you anticipate missing the deadline, notify management before the end of your scheduled working hours. Explain the blocker, what remains, and your estimated completion time. A short extension can be agreed where necessary. Finishing early is welcome, provided the required quality standard is met.



Required Experience and Skills

At least one year of hands-on experience building, managing, or localizing Shopify stores.

Strong working knowledge of Shopify themes, products, markets, languages, shipping, navigation, policies, payments, and checkout.

Practical experience with DeepL and AI tools, particularly translation, image generation, and image editing.

Experience configuring Kaching, Track123, 
, or comparable Shopify apps, including troubleshooting integrations and review imports.

A good eye for web design, typography, visual consistency, and mobile usability.

Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and basic Liquid sufficient to resolve common theme and layout issues.

Clear written English, reliable internet, a suitable computer, and the ability to manage your workload independently.

Attitude and Growth



We want someone open-minded, motivated to grow, and willing to discuss ideas, ask questions, and accept constructive feedback. You should enjoy learning new tools, improving your workflow, and taking ownership of results.



Complete transparency is essential. Report mistakes, delays, uncertainties, and blockers promptly. Never hide an issue or mark incomplete work as finished. Be clear about what you have completed, what you have checked, and what still needs attention.



As you demonstrate reliable execution and stronger technical skills, you may progress into a senior role helping manage Depura’s Shopify stores worldwide. Future responsibilities may include overseeing multiple stores, improving our localization processes, and helping coordinate additional team members.



How to Apply



Send your application via WhatsApp to 
.



Your first message must begin with “Depura Global” to confirm that you have read the entire job posting.



Please include:



A brief introduction and a summary of your relevant Shopify experience.

Links to two or three stores you have worked on, explaining your exact responsibilities.

Examples of translated store pages or localized images you have created.

The AI and translation tools you use, including your experience with DeepL, Kaching, Track123, and 
.

A short explanation of how you would prepare an existing Italian Shopify store for a new country.

Your availability, time zone, and confirmation that you understand the $500 USD starting monthly salary, work schedule, and daily delivery target.

title: Life Insurance Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting Virtual Assistant
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking experienced, highly motivated Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting Virtual Assistants to support a growing life insurance company.



This is a performance-driven sales role focused primarily on outbound calling to cold leads, creating interest, having quality conversations, and booking qualified appointments for the sales team.



We are looking for candidates who are exceptional on the phone, confident speaking with cold prospects, comfortable overcoming objections, and motivated by measurable results.



Candidates should have at least 2 years of successful outbound calling, appointment setting, or phone-based sales experience. Life insurance experience is a plus but is not required.



Key Responsibilities:

* Make a high volume of outbound calls to cold leads

* Engage prospects quickly and professionally

* Build rapport and create interest over the phone

* Clearly communicate the reason for the call and value proposition

* Ask effective questions to identify interest and potential needs

* Handle common objections confidently

* Follow established scripts while communicating naturally

* Book qualified appointments for the sales team

* Follow up consistently with leads who do not initially schedule

* Maintain accurate lead notes, dispositions, and follow-up information

* Manage leads and activities within the CRM

* Consistently work toward established calling, appointment, and performance goals



Required Qualifications:

* 2+ years of demonstrated success in outbound calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, or phone-based sales

* Excellent spoken English

* Exceptional phone presence and communication skills

* Proven ability to successfully book appointments from cold leads

* Strong sales and persuasion skills

* Comfortable handling objections and rejection

* Confident, energetic, and engaging on the phone

* Strong follow-up and organizational skills

* Comfortable using a CRM and managing a sales pipeline

* Self-motivated and able to perform without constant supervision

* Results-oriented and comfortable being measured against clear performance expectations



Required

* Previous life insurance or insurance industry experience

* Experience calling U.S.-based consumers

* Experience working in a commission or performance-incentive environment

* Familiarity with insurance lead generation and appointment-setting processes



Performance Expectations

This is not simply a calling or administrative position. Success will be measured by results.



The right candidate will be expected to consistently:

* Maintain strong outbound calling activity

* Connect and engage effectively with cold prospects

* Generate qualified interest

* Book appointments

* Follow up persistently

* Meet or exceed established performance targets



We want someone who genuinely enjoys sales, is comfortable discussing life insurance with prospects, likes competing against goals, and takes personal ownership of their performance.



Compensation & Incentives:

In addition to hourly compensation, this role will include a commission and/or performance incentive component designed to reward strong results. High performers will have the opportunity to increase their earnings based on their success.



What Success Looks Like:

The right VA will be someone the sales team can confidently give life insurance leads to, knowing they will consistently pick up the phone, create meaningful conversations, explain the value of life insurance, overcome objections, follow up relentlessly, and put qualified appointments on the calendar.



We are looking for proven life insurance appointment setters who understand the industry, know how to work cold leads, want to perform and produce, and are motivated to be rewarded for their results.

title: Head of Operations – Dubai Holiday Homes
description:
Head of Operations – Dubai Holiday Homes



Location: Dubai, UAE

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Holiday Homes / Short-Term Rentals



We are looking for an experienced Head of Operations to take full responsibility for the day-to-day operations of our Dubai holiday-home business.



This is a senior, hands-on operational role for someone who has already worked in Dubai's holiday-home industry and understands what it takes to run a short-term rental portfolio in practice.



We are not looking for a VA, assistant, coordinator or someone who simply follows instructions.



We are looking for someone who can take over the operational function, manage the people and resources available to them, make decisions independently, solve problems and continuously improve the way the business operates.



The ideal candidate should be able to take the operation and say:



"I'll handle it."



About the Role



You will be responsible for the complete operational side of the business.



This means overseeing everything required to keep our properties running smoothly and ensuring that guests receive a good experience.



You will work with our existing on-ground team, cleaners, technicians, managers and vendors, but you will also be expected to build additional resources whenever required.



You will have the authority to make routine operational decisions and will be expected to use good judgment rather than waiting for approval for every small matter.



The owner should not have to become involved in routine operational problems.



If something needs to be done, you are expected to make sure it gets done.



Your Responsibilities

1. Overall Operations



You will have overall responsibility for the operational performance of the portfolio.



This includes:



Managing the day-to-day operation of all properties

Making sure properties are ready for every check-in

Managing check-outs and turnovers

Coordinating cleaners and maintenance

Managing the on-ground team

Monitoring operational issues across properties

Following up on outstanding tasks

Handling urgent situations

Managing vendors and contractors

Ensuring operational standards are maintained

Identifying problems before they become major issues

Improving operational processes and procedures



You should have a clear understanding at any given time of:



What needs to be done, who is doing it, when it will be completed and whether it has actually been completed properly.



2. Housekeeping & Cleaning



You will take responsibility for the housekeeping operation.



This includes:



Scheduling cleaners according to check-ins and check-outs

Ensuring every property is cleaned on time

Checking cleaning quality

Handling cleaning complaints

Organizing deep cleaning

Managing cleaner performance

Building a reliable pool of backup cleaners

Managing linen and towel requirements

Coordinating laundry

Ensuring cleaning supplies are available

Conducting quality-control checks

Replacing cleaners who consistently underperform



If we suddenly have more bookings and don't have enough cleaners, you are expected to solve the problem.



For example, you may need to:



Search Dubai cleaning groups on

Contact individual cleaners

Speak to cleaning companies

Interview or screen cleaners

Negotiate rates

Arrange trial cleanings

Build a backup pool



You should not simply tell management:



"We don't have enough cleaners."



You should come back with:



"I've found three additional cleaners and arranged their trial shifts."



3. Maintenance & Repairs



You will oversee the entire maintenance function.



This includes:



AC issues

Plumbing

Electrical problems

Appliances

TVs and electronics

Internet/Wi-Fi issues

Furniture

Locks and access systems

Painting

General handyman work

Emergency repairs

Preventive maintenance



We have in-house technical resources, but you are not limited to them.



If our technician cannot solve a problem, you are expected to find someone who can.



For example, if an in-house technician cannot repair a television:



You should be able to identify the problem, search for suitable Dubai vendors, contact them, compare availability and pricing, arrange the repair and follow up until the issue is resolved.



The same applies to any other specialist service.



If we don't currently have a suitable vendor, you find one.



4. Building & Managing Vendors



A strong Operations Head should continuously build a reliable network of vendors.



You will be expected to develop relationships with vendors for services such as:



AC specialists

Plumbers

Electricians

TV/electronics repair

Appliance repair

Locksmiths

Pest control

Painters

Handymen

Furniture repair

Cleaning companies

Laundry companies

Emergency contractors

Other specialist services



You can source vendors through:



Google

 groups

Local business networks

Recommendations

Existing contacts

Vendor referrals

Other suitable channels



You should also maintain information about reliable vendors, pricing, response times and quality.



If a vendor repeatedly performs poorly, replace them.



5. Guest Support & Escalations



You will not be expected to personally answer every routine guest message.



However, when a guest has a serious or complicated operational issue, you are expected to take ownership.



This may involve calling the guest directly.



Examples include:



Guest cannot access the property

AC has stopped working

Property has a serious maintenance problem

Cleaning was not completed properly

Guest is missing an essential item

Guest has an urgent complaint

A technician needs to be sent immediately

A problem is not being resolved by the normal team



You should be comfortable speaking directly with guests, understanding the problem, coordinating the appropriate resources and following the issue through to resolution.



The objective is not simply to respond to the guest.



The objective is to solve the problem.



6. On-Ground Team Management



You will manage and coordinate the operational resources available to the business.



This may include:



Cleaners

Technicians

Property managers

Inspectors

Maintenance staff

Laundry resources

External contractors

Other support staff



You will be responsible for d
 how resources are deployed.



For example:



A property has a maintenance issue at 12 PM and another property has a turnover at 1 PM.



You should be able to assess the situation, d
 which resource should go where, arrange the required support and make sure both issues are handled.



You should not need management to coordinate every operational movement.



7. Procurement & Operational Purchases



You will be responsible for ensuring the business has the supplies and equipment it needs.



This can include:



Cleaning supplies

Towels

Bed linen

Toiletries

Kitchen supplies

Maintenance materials

Replacement items

Small appliances

Property consumables

Other operational requirements



You will have access to company resources for legitimate operational purchases, subject to company policies and accounting procedures.



If you notice that stock is running low, you should order it before it becomes an emergency.



We want someone who thinks ahead rather than waiting until something is completely finished.



8. Property Inspections & Quality Control



You will be responsible for maintaining standards across the portfolio.



This includes ensuring:



Properties are properly cleaned

Furniture is in good condition

Appliances are working

AC is functioning properly

Bathrooms and kitchens are maintained

Linen is available and in good condition

Consumables are stocked

Maintenance issues are identified

Properties are ready before guest arrival



You should establish proper inspection and quality-control procedures rather than relying entirely on guest complaints to discover problems.



9. Preventive Maintenance



We don't want an operation where we only repair things after guests complain.



You will be expected to identify recurring problems and introduce preventive measures.



For example:



If an AC repeatedly develops an issue, you should investigate why.



If the same appliance repeatedly fails, you should determine whether it needs replacement.



If a particular property consistently has plumbing issues, you should investigate the underlying cause.



The goal is to reduce recurring problems and emergency call-outs.



10. Recruitment & Building the Team



As the business grows, you will be responsible for identifying operational staffing requirements.



If we need more:



Cleaners

Technicians

Handymen

Inspectors

Property staff

Other operational resources



you should be capable of finding and screening suitable people.



You may use
 groups, referrals, recruitment platforms, agencies, local networks and other appropriate channels.



You will also be expected to identify underperforming staff and make recommendations regarding replacement, training or restructuring.



11. SOPs & Operational Systems



You will be expected to improve the way the company operates.



This includes developing and maintaining SOPs for areas such as:



Check-in preparation

Check-out procedures

Cleaning

Inspections

Maintenance

Emergency situations

Guest complaints

Inventory

Laundry

Vendor management

Staff responsibilities

Property readiness



If a process repeatedly creates problems, you should identify the reason and improve the process.



The Type of Person We Want



We are looking for someone who is:



Proactive

Independent

Practical

Decisive

Resourceful

Organized

Comfortable managing people

Comfortable dealing with vendors

Comfortable speaking with guests

Good under pressure

Good at prioritizing

Strong at follow-up

Comfortable making decisions

Focused on solving problems



Most importantly, you must take ownership.



If you don't know how to solve something, you find someone who does.



If we don't have a vendor, you find one.



If we don't have enough cleaners, you recruit them.



If the existing technician cannot solve the issue, you find a specialist.



If a guest has a problem, you make sure it gets resolved.



Mandatory Experience

Dubai holiday-home experience is required.



You must have previously worked for a Dubai holiday-home / short-term rental company in a senior operations position.



We are specifically looking for someone who has previously held a position such as:



Head of Operations

Operations Head

Senior Operations Manager



within a holiday-home company.



You should already understand the practical realities of operating holiday homes in Dubai.



Experience managing properties listed on Airbnb, 
 and other short-term rental platforms is highly relevant.



Candidates without previous senior Dubai holiday-home operations experience will not be considered.



General hotel experience alone is not sufficient.



General office-management experience is not sufficient.



Long-term property management experience alone is not sufficient.



This Is NOT a VA / Assistant Position



We want to be very clear about this.



You will not be sitting around waiting for management to send you a list of tasks.



You will be expected to create your own priorities based on what is happening in the operation.



If you see something that needs to be done, you should deal with it.



If you see a recurring problem, you should fix the process.



If you see that the team is short-staffed, you should address it.



If you see that a vendor is unreliable, you should find an alternative.



If you see that something can be done more efficiently, you should improve it.



We are hiring someone to run operations, not someone to assist the person running operations.

Compensation



Salary: Competitive and based on experience.



The final package will depend on your previous Dubai holiday-home experience, portfolio size managed, team size managed and overall operational responsibility.



Application Process



We are keeping the application process simple.



1. Send us a private message



If you are interested, simply contact us privately and state that you are applying for the Head of Operations position.



2. We will send you a private interview link



You will receive a link to complete our initial interview.



3. Complete the interview



The interview will focus heavily on real-world operational situations and your previous experience.



We want to understand how you actually handle problems, people, vendors, guests and day-to-day operations.



4. Selection



Candidates will be assessed based on their experience, operational knowledge, judgment, leadership, problem-solving and ability to independently run a Dubai holiday-home operation.



If you have genuinely run operations for a Dubai holiday-home company and believe you can take complete ownership of the role, send us a private message to receive the interview link.

title: Finance Manager for a UK-based CFO
description:
A CFO overseeing a portfolio of five fast-growing, product-based and retail brands across the UK is looking to build up the capability of the finance function properly, not just keep it running as is.



Right now, the CFO handles the bulk of the accounting personally, bookkeeping through to forecasting, across all five businesses. We're hiring a Finance Manager to take full ownership of that function and build it into something stronger, working closely with the CFO.



This is a senior, hands-on role built around real ownership, not a narrow, single-client bookkeeping job. The portfolio is a focused set of five brands, sized deliberately so the role is about doing the work well, not managing volume.



Because the five businesses vary in size, sector and complexity, the scope of this role will shift as needs change. You'll need to be comfortable adapting to what each one requires rather than working from a fixed, unchanging list of tasks.



Important



This role isn't suited to someone who wants to keep their head down and do the basics. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of problems from discovery through to resolution, who questions how things are done and pushes for a better way when something doesn't add up, and who can hold a confident, informed conversation with the CFO about the numbers.



This is not a client-facing role. Your focus is on building and running the finance function itself.



What You'll Be Responsible For

1. Financial Reporting & Accounting

- Month-end close and management reporting across multiple client accounts

- Maintaining accurate financial records and reconciliations

- Supporting year-end accounting

2. Inventory & Operational Finance

- Inventory and landed cost accounting

- Retail deductions and operational finance support

- Managing and reconciling large datasets across multiple systems

3. Forecasting & Analysis

- Building and maintaining financial models, forecasts and cash flow projections

- Investigating and resolving discrepancies and variances independently

- Ad hoc financial and operational analysis

4. Process & Relationship Ownership

- Improving finance processes and workflows across the portfolio

- Running the day-to-day finance function with minimal oversight

- Representing the numbers with confidence when speaking with founders and stakeholders



What We're Looking For

- Proven experience running a finance function independently, not just contributing to one within a larger team

- Experience managing the finance function across multiple client accounts or entities at once, comfortable prioritising and moving between businesses of different sizes and complexity

- Genuine hands-on experience building management accounts and forecasts from scratch

- Comfortable producing forward-looking analysis and insight, not only reviewing and flagging issues in bookkeeping

- Strong accounting background with real exposure to product-based or inventory-heavy businesses

- Hands-on experience with inventory accounting, landed costs, reconciliations and operational finance workflows

- Experience with Amazon or e-commerce accounting operations and large transaction datasets

- Fluent in tools such as Xero, Zoho Books, QuickBooks Online and BI or reporting platforms

- CPA preferred or other similar certifications

- A confident, articulate communicator who is comfortable pushing back and defending their analysis with sound reasoning

- Naturally investigative, someone who wants to understand a business well enough to question its numbers, not simply record them

- Retail or wholesale accounting experience is a strong advantage



Working Setup

This is a fully remote, full-time position working UK business hours. To be considered for this role, you must have:

- A reliable computer suitable for remote work

- A fast, stable primary internet connection, with a backup option available in case of an outage

- A quiet, professional workspace free from background noise and interruptions

- A good quality headset for clear communication

- A dedicated work environment where you can attend meetings and work without distractions



What Success Looks Like In This Role

Success in this role means leadership can confidently rely on you to own the numbers, reporting, forecasting, and finance operations without needing constant oversight.

You don’t need to be an expert in every area. What matters most is that you have solid experience in at least one or two areas of e-commerce and are willing to learn and take ownership of your work.



What You’ll Work On

Your responsibilities may include:



Researching potential Halloween and seasonal products for the US market

Evaluating products based on demand, competition, pricing, margins, and market potential

Researching competitors and identifying opportunities or gaps

Finding product angles and ideas that could work for US customers

Adding and managing products in Shopify

Improving product titles, descriptions, images, collections, and overall product presentation

Helping organize and optimize the Shopify store

Assisting with
/Instagram Ads and/or Google Ads

Researching and testing different products, creatives, audiences, and marketing angles

Monitoring basic sales and advertising performance

Identifying what is working and what needs to be improved

Sharing your own ideas and recommendations

We’re Looking for Someone Who Thinks, Not Just Someone Who Executes

“Is there a better way to do this?”



If you find a product, we want you to be able to explain why you think it has potential.

If an ad or product doesn’t perform well, we want you to think about what could be changed and tested next.

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have Experience With

Shopify

E-commerce

Dropshipping

Product research

Competitor research

/Instagram Ads

Google Ads

Product listing and optimization

Online marketing

US e-commerce markets

We care more about ability, reliability, curiosity, and willingness to improve than having a perfect resume.



What We Value

We’re particularly interested in people who are:



Reliable and consistent

Proactive rather than waiting for instructions

Detail-oriented

Comfortable researching and learning independently

Good at communicating ideas clearly

Able to meet deadlines

Interested in understanding the “why” behind a task

Willing to take responsibility for their work

Interested in building long-term e-commerce skills

title: Construction Estimator / Bid Coordinator
description:
We are hiring an experienced Construction Estimator / Bid Coordinator to support a growing U.S.-based construction and facilities services company.



This is a hands-on construction role covering two major workstreams:



1. Government / Prime Contractor Bids

Supporting federal, state, and municipal solicitations as a prime contractor.



2. General Contractor / Subcontractor Bids

Preparing bids for self-performed construction and facility services for national and regional general contractors.



This is not a general administrative or data-entry position. You will work directly with construction documents, specifications, subcontractors, general contractors, pricing, bid requirements, and multiple active opportunities simultaneously.



The client typically has 6–10 active pursuits running in parallel, across multiple U.S. states, each with its own scope, documentation, subcontractors, and deadlines.



We are looking for someone with genuine construction estimating experience who can take ownership of the bid process with minimal supervision.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Government / Prime Contractor Bids

Monitor 
 and other U.S. procurement portals for relevant solicitations.

Track amendments, Q&A deadlines, site visits, and bid submission deadlines.

Review PWS, SOWs, specifications, drawings, and solicitation documents.

Extract scope requirements, forms, certifications, submittals, deadlines, and compliance requirements.

Identify required trades and subcontractors.

Research and source qualified subcontractors in the project geography, including unfamiliar markets.

Contact subcontractors by phone and
 to discuss scope and obtain pricing.

Communicate scope requirements, site requirements, payment terms, personnel requirements, and quote deadlines.

Collect, organize, compare, and evaluate subcontractor proposals.

Identify exclusions, scope gaps, pricing inconsistencies, and items requiring clarification.

Follow up persistently with subcontractors to obtain quotes before internal deadlines.

Prepare bid schedules, unit-price tables, and required government forms accurately and on time.



Phone outreach is a significant part of this position. You must be comfortable speaking directly with U.S. subcontractors and contractors.



General Contractor / GC Bids



The client also bids self-performed work directly to national and regional general contractors, including:



Post-construction cleaning

Rough and final cleaning

Interior and exterior glass

Pressure washing

Division 9 and Division 10 scopes

Related facility and finishing services



You will:



Monitor invitations to bid through
 and GC bid platforms.

Review ITBs, plans, specifications, and project schedules.

Identify the complete scope of work, including requirements located in other specification sections.

Complete GC bid forms accurately, including alternates, unit prices, allowances, sales tax treatment, bond and insurance requirements, union status, parking requirements, and project-specific exhibits.

Prepare and submit proposals to GC estimating and preconstruction contacts.

Confirm receipt of submitted bids.

Follow up consistently with GCs until the opportunity is awarded or closed.

Track bid-date changes, competitiveness, expected award timing, and feedback.

Maintain a live log of outstanding GC quotes, including project, GC, contact, value, submission date, last contact, next follow-up date, and status.

Support scope clarification and change-order documentation on awarded projects.



ESTIMATING & BID COORDINATION



Across both workstreams, you will:



Review lengthy construction documents and quickly identify critical requirements.

Extract and organize information from complex project documents.

Build and maintain multi-tab Excel pricing workbooks.

Use linked formulas properly rather than hardcoding values where formulas belong.

Verify that inputs flow correctly through dependent tabs before submission.

Maintain accurate estimating, bid, subcontractor, and quote records.

Manage multiple active bids and competing deadlines simultaneously.

Communicate professionally with subcontractors, vendors, GCs, contracting officers, and other stakeholders.

Use AI and other technology tools to improve document review, research, sourcing, and estimating workflows.



CONFIDENTIALITY & DOCUMENT CONTROL



Confidentiality is a non-negotiable requirement of this role.



You will be expected to:



Properly redact solicitation numbers, agency/end-client identities, and project-identifying information from documents before subcontractor outreach when required.

Ensure unredacted project details are released only when authorized.

Clearly identify documents as internal or external before sending them outside the company.

Ensure client-facing documents contain only approved billing information.

Never disclose internal cost data, margins, payroll information, or other confidential information to clients, GCs, or subcontractors.

Properly communicate and enforce non-circumvention requirements in subcontractor correspondence.



REMOTE WORK & HUBSTAFF



This is a fully remote position supporting a U.S.-based construction client.



Hubstaff will be used for time tracking and work activity monitoring.



You must be comfortable working independently in a structured remote environment and maintaining consistent productivity during scheduled U.S. business hours.



You are expected to:



Accurately track working hours through Hubstaff.

Remain available during agreed working hours.

Maintain reliable communication with the client and team.

Respond promptly to time-sensitive bid and subcontractor matters.

Meet deadlines without constant follow-up.

Take ownership of assigned bids from start to finish.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

5+ years of experience in construction estimating, bid coordination, construction procurement, or a closely related role.

Demonstrated experience reading and interpreting PWS, SOWs, specifications, plans, or other construction documents.

Hands-on experience sourcing subcontractors and discussing scope and pricing by phone.

Strong Excel skills, particularly multi-tab workbooks with linked formulas.

Strong spoken and written English.

Professional and confident phone presence.

Experience managing multiple bids, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

Strong organization and follow-through.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Availability during U.S. business hours across multiple time zones.

Ability to make and receive calls through a U.S.-reachable phone number.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



The following are a strong advantage:



Experience with federal procurement and 
.

Familiarity with CLIN structures, set-asides, bid schedules, and wage determinations.

Knowledge of Service Contract Act (SCA) and Davis-Bacon requirements.

Experience with GC bid invitation platforms.

Experience with post-construction cleaning, Division 9/10 trades, or facility services.

Experience performing quantity takeoffs from drawings.

Familiarity with Bluebeam or construction estimating software.

Experience using AI tools for document review, research, sourcing, or estimating.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for a construction professional who can hit the ground running.



You should be someone who:



Understands construction documents rather than simply processing them.

Can identify scope gaps and potential issues.

Is comfortable speaking directly with U.S. contractors and subcontractors.

Can source subcontractors in unfamiliar markets.

Can evaluate and normalize competing quotes.

Can manage several active bids without losing track of deadlines.

Follows up proactively instead of waiting for responses.

Takes ownership and keeps the bid pipeline moving.

Knows when to make a recommendation and when to escalate a decision.



If your experience is primarily administrative or data-entry based, this is not the right role.



If you have genuine construction estimating experience and enjoy the challenge of getting bids across the finish line, we want to hear from you.



SCOPE OF AUTHORITY



You will own the estimating and bid coordination process, but you will not have final authority over pricing or contractual commitments.



You will prepare, organize, analyze, and recommend, but you will not:



Set final pricing or margins.

Make final bid/no-bid decisions.

Sign or commit the company to a subcontractor, general contractor, or government agency.



The expectation is ownership of the process, not authority over the final number.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted candidates will be evaluated through practical work samples, not interview answers alone.



Candidates may be asked to complete:



1. Document Extraction Exercise



Given a 40–60 page PWS, produce a one-page summary within one hour identifying:



Scope

Required trades

Submittals and forms

Site visit date

Q&A deadline

Bid due date, time, and time zone



2. Subcontractor Outreach Exercise



Given a live solicitation, prepare the outreach package you would use to contact subcontractors.



3. Quote Normalization Exercise



Given three subcontractor quotes with different inclusions, exclusions, and units, prepare an apples-to-apples comparison and identify the questions you would send back to each subcontractor.



4. Live Call / Role Play



Participate in a short scope and pricing call to assess your communication skills and phone presence.



APPLICATION QUESTION



Please answer this question in your application:



Walk us through the most recent federal solicitation or GC bid package you personally worked on. What was the project, what was your role, and what did you personally produce?



Please provide specific details about your hands-on work. Generic descriptions of your previous employer's responsibilities will not be sufficient.



READY TO TAKE OWNERSHIP OF THE BID PROCESS?



If you have real construction estimating experience, strong construction document skills, confidence communicating with U.S. contractors, and the ability to manage multiple bids independently, we'd like to hear from you.



To apply:



Complete the application form.

Upload your updated CV.

Submit your short introduction video.

Answer the application question about the most recent federal solicitation or GC bid package you personally worked on.



Please be specific about your hands-on experience. We are looking for someone who has actually worked on construction bids—not someone who has only provided general administrative support.



Apply Here –
