title: Content Strategist / Manager – Video Podcast Remote
description:
Company Overview:

We are 37 Projects, a fast-growing YouTube Video Marketing Agency that helps health and wellness brands maximize their reach through high-quality video content, Shorts, and podcast marketing. We’re looking for a YouTube & Podcast Content Manager who can analyze long-form podcasts, craft compelling YouTube Shorts & Clips, and ensure all content aligns with the client’s brand voice and audience engagement strategies.



I. Content Manager Responsibilities



1. Content Consumption

- Watch 1–2 hour video podcasts on health, fitness, and nutrition topics.

- Develop a deep understanding of each podcast’s themes and key messages to inform content creation.



2. Clip & Short Identification (NOT Editing)

- Identify segments ideal for YouTube Clips and YouTube Shorts.

- Select the best 
nts for intros that build a compelling storytelling narrative.



3. Content Strategy & Quality Assurance

- Ensure all clips, shorts, and intros align with the client’s brand voice and content strategy.

- Perform content-only quality checks on first rough-cut videos (focus on flow, clarity, and messaging—not captions, graphics, or motion design).



II. Scope of Work

- Manage content across five clients.

- Watch and process around 15–16 podcasts per month (on average, 3–4 per client).

- Produce selections for around 8 trailers per month (?2 per week, one per client).

- Deliverables include weekly clips, shorts, and trailers, ensuring consistency across all client channels.

- Collaborate closely with Project Managers and Video Editors to maintain smooth production flow and client satisfaction.



III Requirements:

1. Availability & Commitment:

- Full-time remote position - no other job commitments to ensure focus.

- Must have a high-performance laptop/computer and stable internet.



2. Experience & Education:

- Proven experience in video editing or podcast production (video/audio).

- Graduates in Communication, Multimedia, or Video Production are highly preferred.

- Experience in YouTube content creation (Shorts, Clips, long-form podcasts) - a bonus



3. Skills & Tools:

- SEO writing experience is a plus.

- Strong organizational and time management skills to handle multiple projects.

- Proficiency in:

   + Slack

   + Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive)

   + Notion

   + AI writing tools (ChatGPT, Claude)

   + YouTube SEO tools (VidIQ, SEMrush) – a bonus



4. Strong storytelling ability to identify and structure the most compelling 
nts in videos.



5. Preferred Bonus Skills:

- Knowledge of health, fitness, and nutrition topics (to select key 
nts effectively).

- Creative mindset with the ability to suggest innovative content formats & strategies.

Fill out this form to apply:

title: Freelance Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
Freelance Graphic Designer & Video Editor



We are looking for a talented Freelance Graphic Designer & Video Editor to support two fast-growing health and wellness beverage brands with creative assets for Meta ads, social media, and digital campaigns.



This role is ideal for someone who understands how to create scroll-stopping visuals, stays updated with current design and social media trends, and can adapt across different brand styles — from modern, clean, and minimalistic to girly, playful, bold, and creative.



Responsibilities:

- Design static and animated creatives (e.g. story ad) for Meta ads, Instagram, TikTok, and other social media platforms

- Edit short-form videos for ads, reels, stories, and organic social content

- Create visually engaging social media posts, banners, product graphics, and campaign assets

title: Client Success Manager / Operations Coordinator
description:
The role

You are the single point of contact for our clients and the person who keeps delivery moving internally. Half the job is client success: onboarding, weekly comms, reporting, and keeping accounts happy and renewing. The other half is ops: making sure every client request becomes a tracked task, gets QA'd, launches on time, and nothing goes stale.



What you'll own



Client success (~50%)

Own client relationships end-to-end: onboarding calls, weekly/bi-weekly check-ins, monthly performance reviews.

Translate performance data (leads, appointments kept, cost per kept appointment) into plain-English updates clients actually understand.

Spot churn risk early — slow lead flow, low show rates, quiet clients — and escalate with a fix, not just a flag.

Collect creative assets, offers, approvals and account access without being chased.





Ops / project coordination (~50%)

Run the ClickUp board: every client request becomes a task with owner, due date, and status. No orphan requests.

Traffic the creative → QA → launch → optimization loop; chase blockers and keep QA from becoming a bottleneck.

Own the Slack request pipeline: intake, prioritization, daily standup of what's due, end-of-day recap of what shipped.

Maintain and improve SOPs so the process survives without heroics.

Keep trackers, reporting sheets, and dashboards accurate and current.





You're a fit if you have

2+ years in client success, account management, or agency project coordination (paid media / marketing agency strongly preferred).

Excellent written English — clear, calm, professional under pressure.

Comfort with performance numbers: CPL, show rate, cost per kept appointment. You don't need to build ads, but you must read a report and know what's off.

Hands-on with ClickUp (or Asana/Monday), Slack, Google Sheets; HighLevel and Meta Ads Manager experience is a big plus.

Ruthless follow-through. You close loops without reminders.





Nice to have: experience with home-services or local lead-gen clients, appointment-setting funnels, light copy/creative brief writing.



Success in the first 90 days

Days 1–30: know every client, their offer and their numbers; own the ClickUp board and daily standup.

Days 31–60: run all client comms and monthly reporting independently; QA-to-launch cycle time down measurably.

Days 61–90: zero stale tasks >7 days, no missed client check-ins, documented SOPs for intake → launch → report.





How to apply

Send a short note with: (1) an agency/client-facing role you've held and how many accounts, (2) the PM tool you ran and how

You MUST already know this business and have access to these types of price sheets.

$200 + GOOD BONUSES

No sample = application will not be considered.

title: Direct Response Video Editor - Paid Pilot → Full-Time Role
description:
We're looking for an exceptional Direct Response Video Editor based in the Philippines to join our team.



This will begin with a paid pilot project.



If you perform exceptionally well, there is an opportunity to move into a long-term/full-time position editing ads across our client accounts.



We're not looking for someone who simply makes videos look good.



We're looking for someone who understands that editing ads is sales, not cinema.



Your job is to create ads that capture attention immediately, maintain retention, communicate the message clearly, use pattern interrupts intentionally, match the target audience and ultimately help the ad convert.



You'll be given a detailed editing SOP that explains exactly how we want our ads approached.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



1. SPEED



You need to be fast.



We operate quickly and need an editor who can turn projects around without sacrificing quality.



You should have an organised workflow and the ability to move through projects efficiently.



2. QUALITY



Fast does not mean sloppy.



Your edits need to feel polished, intentional and professional.



We're particularly interested in editors experienced with:



Direct-response ads

Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising

Short-form video

Hooks and retention editing

Captions

B-roll

Sound design

Motion graphics

Visual representations

Pattern interrupts

Premiere Pro / After Effects



3. RESPONSIVENESS



This is extremely important.



We do not want to wait 12–24 hours every time we send you a message.



You don't need to be online every second of the day, but during agreed working hours we expect fast, reliable communication.



If something is unclear, ask.



If something is going to be late, tell us BEFORE the deadline.



If we request a revision, acknowledge it quickly.



If you're someone who disappears halfway through projects, do not apply.



4. ABILITY TO FOLLOW AN SOP



Creativity is important, but so is following instructions.



We have developed a specific editing SOP and expect you to follow it closely.



We don't want someone who ignores the process because they personally prefer another editing style.



Understand the SOP → execute it → then use your judgement where appropriate.



5. DIRECT-RESPONSE THINKING



We're not hiring a cinematic editor.



We're hiring someone who understands why an edit exists.



Every zoom, caption, B-roll clip, sound effect, animation and pattern interrupt should have a reason for being there.



Clarity > cleverness.



THE PILOT



Shortlisted candidates will receive:



Raw footage

Project context

Target audience information

Our editing SOP

Required assets

Clear deliverables



You'll then complete a paid pilot edit.



This is a real evaluation for an ongoing role - not free spec work.



We're evaluating:



Quality

Speed

SOP adherence

Communication

Responsiveness



If your pilot is exceptional, we'll discuss bringing you onto the team for ongoing client work.



HOW TO APPLY



Read this carefully.



The FIRST word of your application must be: OPTIMALLY



If OPTIMALLY isn't the first word of your application, your application will automatically be ignored.



Then send us:



1. YOUR 3 BEST DIRECT-RESPONSE AD EDITS



Do not send us 20 videos.



Send the three pieces of work that best demonstrate your ability to edit paid social ads that hold attention and sell.



For each one, briefly explain what YOU personally edited.



2. A 2–4 MINUTE LOOM VIDEO



In the Loom, explain:



Who you are

Your experience editing direct-response ads

Why you believe you're an exceptional fit for this specific role

How you balance speed with quality

How you approach following detailed SOPs

How quickly you normally respond to clients/team members during working hours

Why we should choose you over the other editors applying



Please speak naturally. We don't need a scripted corporate presentation.



3. YOUR AVAILABILITY



Tell us:



Your current working hours in Philippine Time

How many hours per week you currently have available

Whether you're currently working with other clients/employers

When you could start

Whether you'd be interested in a full-time position if the pilot goes well



4. PILOT TURNAROUND



Tell us how quickly you could realistically complete a set of 10 ~60-second direct-response ads after receiving all required assets.



5. PILOT PRICE



Tell us your fixed price for completing the paid pilot.



Please give us your genuine rate. We're looking for someone we can build a long-term working relationship with, not simply the cheapest editor.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a core member of the team, not someone looking to pick up another random freelance project.



If you're extremely good, reliable, fast, responsive and coachable, there is significant room to grow with us.



Remember:



FIRST WORD: OPTIMALLY

title: Lead Media Buyer (Meta Ads) for a live music marketing agency
description:
We run
 and Instagram ads for bands and live music venues in Australia, Canada, the US and Europe. Our whole job is selling tickets to shows. It's fast, it's fun, and every campaign has a hard deadline: the night of the gig.



We're growing faster than we can keep up with, and we need a senior media buyer to take the lead on delivery.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



You'll be the person across every ad account. Not one client, all of them. Some clients run 16 shows a month, so you'll be juggling a lot of campaigns at once. You'll need a clear head, to be across all of it, and to know what to do first and what to hand off when there isn't time to do everything yourself.



Day to day, that means:



- Watching the data across all accounts and spotting problems before the client does

- Knowing what to do when a campaign is tanking, and doing it

- Making sure pixel, CAPI and purchase events are set up and firing on every account

- Making creative suggestions to the team based on what's actually working

- Directing our media buyers and video editors on what needs to happen this week, writing the tasks, and following up to make sure it's done

- Jumping into Canva or CapCut when something small needs fixing and it's faster to just do it yourself

- Noticing when something needs doing and just doing it



You will have
 contact with clients, but you won't be on calls with them. The founder handles that. Your job is to make sure the ads are working and the team knows what to do. That said, we're not ruling out client calls down the track, so if getting in front of clients is something you'd never want to do, this isn't the right fit.



MUST HAVE



- At least 5 years hands-on Meta ads buying, with purchase-optimised campaigns and real budgets, and you can show us

- You can diagnose an account. When something drops, you know where to look

- Meta pixel and CAPI. You've set them up, tested them, and fixed them when they broke

- You've managed many accounts and campaigns at the same time without dropping things

- You can lead. You'll be telling the team what to do, and they need to trust you know

- Clear written and spoken English. We're a remote team and we talk a lot in written form and on calls

- You figure things out. If you don't know something, you go and find out before you ask

- You're enthusiastic, hungry and curious. You ask questions and you want to get better

- You're kind and respectful, and you're always willing to help



NICE TO HAVE



- Basic Canva skills (or willing to learn)

- Basic or advanced video editing sills 

- Experience with events, ticketing or anything with a hard deadline



HOURS AND TIME ZONE



Our team is mostly Philippines-based. 9am to 5pm Philippine time is fine for now. If you can start earlier, even better, we'd love 7am. This may change down the track, so please only apply if you're open to that conversation later.



Remote, ongoing, full time. We use Slack, ClickUp and Meta Ads Manager.



WHO THIS SUITS



Someone senior who's ready to run the ads side of a small agency without hand-holding. You're proactive, you don't wait to be told, and you'd rather fix the thing than write a paragraph about the thing. If you tick most of this but not all of it, and you're hungry and you can lead, still apply.



HOW TO APPLY



Reply with:



1. Your expected monthly rate for full-time hours



2. Two or three examples of accounts you've run, with the numbers you're proud of (screenshots welcome)



3. One example of an account that was tanking and what you did about it



4. Your earliest start date



Put the word DRUMSTICK at the start of your application so we know you've read this properly.



Use AI if it helps you write. We use it every day. But the answers need to come from your own accounts and your own head. If you paste this ad into ChatGPT and send us what it gives you without adding your own experience, we'll know.



We'll be reviewing applications over the weekend and booking video calls with shortlisted people next week. We'll go through these questions on the call, plus some we haven't asked here, and you'll be answering live. We want the real you, not a prompt, so we can work out if this is the right fit for both of us.

title: Operations Specialist (Education - Remote)
description:
We’re an education team with a mission to build Singapore’s fastest math learning system for 13-16 year old youths taking the national O level exams



Because students shouldn’t have to trade time to discover their interests for academics.



Most students lack the motivation or strategy to study.



This is why we’re the first and only centre to remove homework and replace it with a weekly self practice class so that we don’t rely on motivation, but build a discipline of doing the hard things consistently as a group.



It is powered by our teachers and data analytics software that assesses their strengths and weaknesses, then gives them the exact plan to score an A.



Now we’re chasing an “impossible” goal: 100% As by 2028.



We’re hiring a Customer Operations specialist to work alongside our Head of Operations to ensure that our processes are running smoothly. You will be the bridge between teachers, students and parents, taking ownership of all processes outside of class that supports the learning experience.



Join our fast growing young founding team designed to accelerate your career while changing the entire industry.



How this will be different for you:

- 100% remote work in the same timezone. Our lean team is fully remote based across Singapore.

- Top compensation and promotions based on the outcomes you’re able to achieve.

- You will constantly be challenged and learning every day in this role. We will train and develop you to become a future leader.

- Heavy use of AI / automation tools to automate work (we have a development team)

- Yearly company off site retreats (that will be planned by you)



Click this link to apply:

title: Video Editor
description:
Expectations of the Role

Produce 7-14 short-form videos per week, aligned with Quantum’s brand guidelines and platform standards.

Produce 1 long-form video per week, maintaining quality and consistency.

Edit 3-5 sales/funnel videos per month, as needed.

Support content research and the development of newscript batches.

Help update and maintain content tracking tools, scheduling calendars, and publishing timelines (with support from the team).

Upload, or coordinate the uploading of, video content to relevant social media platforms.

Use our tools CapCut, Claude, Vista Social, and HubSpot to produce and manage video efficiently.

title: Marketing & Operations Assistant – Long-Term Role
description:
Marketing & Operations Assistant – Long-Term Role



Hi, I'm Pip! I run Cairns Property Clearances, a growing small business based in Cairns, Australia. My husband also runs his own demolition business, and I'm looking for someone who can become a valued, long-term member of our team.



The majority of the role will initially be supporting my business, particularly with marketing, social media and digital tasks, with some work for my husband's business as well.



I'm looking for someone who is proactive, positive, organised and genuinely enjoys working closely with a small-business owner. I want someone who is comfortable bringing ideas to the table, asking questions when something isn't clear, and helping us continually improve the way we work.



About Cairns Property Clearances



We help clients clear the entire contents of properties, often when they're moving, downsizing, preparing a property for sale or dealing with a deceased estate.



It's a varied and unusual business, which means no two weeks are quite the same. We sell items from the properties through our large local
 community, create before-and-after content from our projects and work with a range of local clients, contractors and property professionals.



If you'd like to get a better feel for our business and the type of work we do, have a look at our
 page, Cairns Property Clearances. We're very active on
 and you'll be able to see plenty of our recent properties and content there.



What you'll initially be helping with



The role will initially have a strong marketing focus, including:



Creating high-quality Canva graphics and marketing material

Managing and posting content on

Monitoring and responding to
 comments and 

Helping manage the online sale of items from properties

Creating reels and short-form video content. We currently use CapCut but are open to other software.

Developing proactive marketing content rather than only posting about current properties

Repurposing photos and videos from previous projects into useful marketing content

Making website updates and improvements. We currently use GoHighLevel.

Helping organise and maintain digital marketing assets

Occasional marketing and administrative support for my husband's demolition business



There will sometimes be time-sensitive
 activity when we're selling items from a property, so some flexibility is important. On occasion, this may involve scheduled evening work responding to
 
.



Over time, I'd like this role to expand beyond marketing and into broader operational support as you learn the businesses and become increasingly familiar with how we work.



AI will be an important part of how we work together



I already work extensively with ChatGPT and use AI throughout my business to help with marketing, planning, systems, communication and improving our processes.



I'm looking for someone who is already a confident and regular user of AI tools and, ideally, can bring additional knowledge and ideas to the table.



I see this as a collaborative relationship between me, you and AI. I want you to actively look for opportunities where AI or technology could make our work faster or more efficient. If we can automate or streamline part of your workload, that's a positive — it gives you more capacity to take on other valuable responsibilities as the role grows.



I'd like to work with someone who:

Has excellent written and spoken English

Has strong professional experience with Canva

Has strong experience using
/Meta for business and marketing

Has experience creating social media content

Is confident creating or editing short-form video/reels

Regularly and proficiently uses ChatGPT and/or other AI tools

Has experience working closely with a small-business owner

Has strong attention to detail and organisational skills

Is confident learning new software and digital tools

Is proactive and comfortable suggesting ideas and improvements rather than always waiting for instructions

Has good judgement and the confidence to ask questions when something isn't clear

Has a positive, friendly and communicative personality



Experience with GoHighLevel would be helpful but isn't essential if you're confident learning new software.



Most importantly, I'm hoping to find someone who genuinely wants a long-term position and the opportunity to become an increasingly valuable part of our team as the businesses continue to grow.



Hours & availability



The role will initially be approximately 10 hours per week until early November, while we get to know each other, begin training and I have some upcoming travel.



From approximately mid-November, I'll be back in the office and expect the role to increase to around 20–30 hours per week. I'm looking for someone who has the capacity and availability for this to become their primary role, without being stretched too thin across multiple other clients.



I'd like to have one to two regular video catch-ups each week, generally around 7:30–8:00am Philippine time / 9:30–10:00am Cairns time. Monday will usually be our main weekly catch-up, with a second catch-up generally on either Thursday or Friday when needed.



Outside of our catch-ups and occasional time-sensitive tasks, there will be flexibility around when much of the work is completed.



Pay



The starting rate is AUD $10–12 per hour, depending on experience and capability.



We'll have a formal performance and pay review after three months, with opportunities for the role, responsibilities and remuneration to continue growing over time.



If you're interested in applying, please send:

Your résumé, including any relevant work experience

A personalised cover letter relevant to this specific role. I'd love to hear why this particular position interests you and why you think you would be a good fit for our team.

If you already have a portfolio or examples of previous Canva, social media or video work, please include these as well.



I'd really like to get a genuine sense of who you are, how you work and what it is about this particular role that appeals to you.



I'm looking forward to finding one person who can grow with us long term and become a genuinely valued part of our team.

title: Customer Service Assistant & Shopify Product Listing
description:
About us 

We are a growing European online store specialising in sustainable, Montessori-inspired toys for children. We operate in several European countries and are continuing our international expansion. 

We are looking for an accurate and independent assistant who will focus on two key areas: product listing in Shopify and customer service. 



Your responsibilities 

Product listing 

- Create, format and publish new products in Shopify 

- Process product titles, descriptions and specifications 

- Review and implement translations using our fixed formats 

- Set up product images, variants and prices correctly 

- Add collections, tags and product categories 

- Add reviews and supplementary product information 

- Review and improve existing product pages 

- Check that product pages have been published completely and correctly 



Customer service 

- Monitor incoming customer enquiries 

- Draft responses in English and other European languages with the help of translation tools 

- Answer standard questions about orders, delivery, products and returns 

- Monitor orders and shipping issues 

- Identify problems promptly and escalate them internally 

- Review customer communication for content, tone and translation quality 

- Handle frequently asked questions according to our established workflows and templates 



Customer service workflow 

Customer service will not be handed over completely at the start. You will initially prepare responses that are reviewed before they are sent. Because we communicate with customers in several European countries, accurate translations and an appropriate tone of voice are very important to us. 

Once you demonstrate that you can handle customer enquiries carefully and consistently, you will be given more autonomy in dealing with standard questions. Complex situations, complaints and exceptions will always be discussed internally first. 



What we are looking for 

- You have demonstrable experience with Shopify 

- You have experience creating and formatting product listings 

- You work accurately, independently and in a structured manner 

- You have a strong command of English, both spoken and written 

- You can write clear and customer-friendly responses 

- You review your own work carefully 

- You are comfortable working with fixed instructions, formats and SOPs 

- You are available for 10–15 hours per week on an ongoing basis 

- You are interested in a long-term working relationship 



Experience with these tools:

- Shopify 

- ChatGPT or Claude 

- Google Sheets 

- Canva 

- E-commerce customer service systems 

- Translation tools 

- ParcelPanel or other tracking tools 

- Other Shopify apps and e-commerce tools 



Selection process 

1. Send us your CV and a short motivation letter. 

2. Briefly describe your experience with Shopify, product listing and customer service. 

3. Include the code word shown at the bottom of this vacancy in your application. This lets us know that you have read the full vacancy. Applications without the code word will not be considered. 

4. We will select a top three from all applications. 

5. These candidates will receive a paid assessment consisting of the following tasks: 

- Create and fully set up three products in Shopify, including reviews 

- Draft responses to three customer enquiries 



6. We will make our final decision based on the quality and accuracy of the assessment and the candidate’s communication throughout the process.

Business Development

Market & Sales Enablement

Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and proposal-writing skills; able to run structured discovery and turn business needs into clear technical briefs.

Working knowledge of web/mobile apps, APIs, integrations, CRMs, cloud platforms, automation and AI.

Commercial judgment to balance client expectations, technical feasibility and margin.

Excellent written and spoken English; confident engaging Australian clients and senior stakeholders.

Self-directed, detail-oriented and comfortable working with remote, globally distributed teams.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience selling to Australian SMEs, agencies, startups or enterprise clients, ideally with existing local networks.

Experience with offshore/distributed delivery teams.

Familiarity with WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, HubSpot, Salesforce, n8n, ERP or cloud platforms.

Exposure to agentic/generative AI, workflow automation, IoT, firmware or hardware prototyping.

Experience responding to formal tenders or RFPs.

title: Sales Development Representative

VAP Digital Media builds large-scale international B2B events at the front edge of technology. Our four flagship shows — the Global AI Show, Global Blockchain Show, Global Games Show and Global Trading Show — bring founders, enterprise buyers, investors and builders into the same room across AI, Web3, gaming and financial markets.

The role:

You'll hunt for exhibitors and enterprise sponsors — the companies that take floor space and headline slots at our events. This is a high-activity outbound role: get in front of the right decision-makers, qualify them properly, and fill our closers' calendars with real opportunities.

Run live outbound conversations at pace. We work to a benchmark of 40–45 connected pitches a day with marketing and commercial decision-makers — real conversations, not dials. You'll ramp into this over your first few weeks rather than hitting it from day one.



Keep multi-channel pressure on your pipeline — roughly 20–25 targeted
s and 15–20 LinkedIn touches daily, sequenced rather than sprayed.



Book qualified sponsorship discovery meetings straight onto Senior Closers' calendars — we work to 12–15 a week once you're up to speed.



Build your own target lists. Research and identify enterprise sponsors and exhibitors that genuinely fit each show's audience and positioning — an AI infrastructure vendor and a trading broker are not the same pitch.



Qualify before you book. Budget, authority, fit and timing, so every meeting handed over is a real opportunity and not a calendar filler.



Keep the CRM clean. Accurate, current records across every call,
 and touchpoint — your pipeline is only as good as what's logged.



Stay aligned with events and marketing on sponsorship packages, pricing, inventory and availability across all four shows.



Report activity and pipeline progress directly to the Head of Strategy & Delivery.



What we're looking for:

1–3 years of outbound B2B SDR experience.

Comfort sustaining high daily call,
 and LinkedIn volume — and the resilience that comes with outbound.

Working proficiency with CRM hygiene and prospecting tools such as Apollo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

Clear, confident communication with senior marketing and commercial decision-makers.

A track record of consistently hitting weekly meeting-booking targets — be ready to talk numbers.

Self-motivated and effective working independently in a remote, target-driven environment.

Reliable internet connection and a proper remote working setup.



Bonus points for: experience selling event sponsorship, exhibitions or media; familiarity with the AI, Web3, gaming or trading ecosystems; exposure to GCC, APAC or European markets.



Why this role:

You'll sell across four distinct shows and four distinct buyer universes — which means variety, and a much faster education in enterprise selling than a single-product SDR seat gives you. Strong performers here move into closing.

description:

We are a small team building a dog supplement brand for the US market. We love what we do, we move fast and we test a lot. Every week we run new video ads, all of them in English.



The concepts, scripts and raw clips are already done on our side. What we are missing is a good editor who turns that raw material into finished ads we can actually run. That is where you come in.



This is a long-term, ongoing role, not a one-off project. If it works well, there is a steady flow of work every week.



Your job in one sentence: you get raw clips, text and a written spec, sometimes explained in a short Loom video, and you deliver finished ads that are ready to run. When we want to try new ideas, we often work with references. Long term, you can also generate AI clips yourself using our frameworks.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Turn raw clips into finished, ready-to-run ads for Meta and Instagram

- Cut, time and assemble footage so it holds attention from the first second

- Add subtitles and on-screen elements

- Judge whether a clip is usable and clearly flag any video or sequence that is not

- Name every final upload exactly as specified (this is essential)



WHAT WE PROVIDE

- Finished concepts and copy

- A written spec, or a Loom walkthrough

- References when we explore new ideas



WHAT YOU DO NOT NEED

- To develop concepts

- To write or change copy



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Several years of experience editing video ads. Most of ours run 10 to 45 seconds, some may get longer

- Full understanding of Meta and Instagram safe zones. You know what gets cut in Feed, Stories and Reels, and you place things correctly without being told

- A sharp eye for faults in footage, AI-generated or real

- Good written English

- Reliable delivery times



We do not require a specific editing program. Use whatever you are fast in.



OUR TOOL STACK

Slack, Asana, Airtable and Google Drive. Nothing special, but we keep a clear structure and expect all files and statuses to stay tidy.



HOW WE START

If your application looks like a fit, we send you two example ads so you see exactly what we mean, and then we start with a small paid trial project.



WHAT YOU GET

- A long-term role with a steady flow of work every week

- Clear specs, finished copy and raw clips, so you can focus on editing

- Higher rates and more hours as we grow together

- Reliable payment, always on time



HOW WE START

TERMS

title: Virtual Assistant, SEO Delivery
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a part-time Virtual Assistant who sits in every meeting, captures what was agreed, and then makes sure it actually happens. The core of this job is follow-up. You will chase internal team members and external clients until tasks are closed, and you will surface a blockage early rather than reporting it after the deadline has passed.



You need enough SEO knowledge to understand what is being chased and who owns it, and to ask a sensible clarifying question in the room rather than nodding along and getting it wrong later. Admin experience helps but is not a requirement.



Engagement Terms

- Part-time, remote, paid hourly or on a fixed monthly retainer.

- You attend all scheduled internal and client meetings.

- You must be available 30 minutes before and 30 minutes after every meeting. The before block is for prep: last meeting's notes, the open action list, and anything we owe the client that is late. The after block is for output: notes circulated same day and the first round of follow-ups sent immediately, not tomorrow.

- Meeting times follow the client, so many sit within Singapore hours but some will not. You need to be flexible outside a fixed daytime schedule.

- Once you have applied with the subject line I'm your star VA and cleared the interview, you will be added to a WhatsApp group and the relevant client Slack channels.



Key Responsibilities

- Meeting support

- Ask clarifying questions during the meeting when an action item is vague, unowned or undated.

- Prepare the pre-meeting brief in the 30 minutes before: agenda, open items and their current status, and anything overdue on our side.

- Circulate notes in the 30 minutes after, structured as decisions, action items with an owner and a date, and open questions.

Follow-up and chasing

- Follow up with internal stakeholders (writers, editors, SEO specialists, developers) on task status against the agreed dates.

- Follow up with external stakeholders (clients, client-side dev and marketing teams, guest post contacts) for approvals, website access, content sign-off, information and assets.

- Maintain one live tracker of every open item with owner, date requested, date promised, next chase date and status.

- Escalate to the account lead once a chase has failed twice, with a one-line summary of what is stuck and what it is blocking. Do not simply forward the
 thread.

- Flag risk in writing before a deadline is missed, not after.

- Admin support

- Calendar management, scheduling and rescheduling across the team.

- Maintaining trackers, folder structure and file naming in Google Drive.

- Formatting and tidying decks, reports and documents.

- Light data entry into Google Sheets and the project management tool.



Preferred Skills

- Working knowledge of SEO. You do not need to run campaigns, but you should understand on-page, off-page and technical -SEO, what a brief is, what a meta title does, and roughly why rankings take time.

- Confident, persistent follow-up. You are comfortable chasing people more senior than you and clients who have gone quiet.

- Excellent written English. Your notes and chase messages go directly to clients.

- Clear spoken English, since you will be asking questions live on client calls.

- Strong organisation. One tracker, kept current, with nothing held only in your head.

- Google Sheets: filters, sorting, conditional formatting. VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP is a bonus.

- Familiarity with a project management tool (Asana, ClickUp, Trello, Monday or Notion).

- Experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, GA4 or Looker Studio, even at a viewing level.

- Reliable internet with a backup connection, a quiet working space, and a plan for power outages.

### Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or higher.

* Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

* A licensed accountant, or equivalent professional accounting credential preferred but not required.

* Prior experience with billing, accounts receivable, claims processing, insurance billing, legal billing, or accounting strongly preferred.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

title: Customer Support & Admin Specialist (Canadian Client Services)
description:
Shift: Permanent Night Shift (Mon–Fri, 40 hrs/week)

Total Package: PHP 52,300 / month



ABOUT WINSLOW PACIFIC

Winslow Pacific runs the back office for trade contractors across Vancouver Island, British Columbia. From roofers to plumbers, we answer their calls, book their appointments, and keep their schedules organized so they can stay focused on their work.



We’re a registered Canadian startup with a tight-knit, fully remote team. We're looking for a dependable, articulate team member to serve as the voice and main administrative point of contact for a small portfolio of our trade clients.



THE ROLE

When a homeowner’s roof is leaking or their well pump stops working, you’re the calm, steady voice on the line.



You’ll answer inbound calls for a few dedicated contracting companies. To the customer calling in, you aren't an outsourced center - you're a seamless part of that contractor's office. Building and maintaining that trust is central to everything we do.



Your day-to-day responsibilities:

- Handle inbound calls: Light-to-moderate volume (starting around 15 to 20 calls a day).

- Manage schedules & follow-ups: Book appointments, confirm estimates, and handle callback promises promptly.

- Take accurate messages: Capture full, clear details and route them quickly to the right person.

- Provide exceptional customer care: Callers are often stressed about home repairs. Your warmth, patience, and clear communication set their minds at ease.

- Use quiet hours productively: Learn our clients' services, familiarize yourself with Vancouver Island geography (towns, drive times, local names), and help with executive admin tasks (inbox management, calendars, research, data entry) as requested by the Founder



WORK SHIFT & SCHEDULE

Hours: Monday to Friday, 11:00 PM – 7:00 AM Manila Time (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Pacific Time).

Status: 40 hours/week, permanent night shift.



This is a permanent graveyard role, so we want to be upfront about the hours. If night shifts fit your current routine and lifestyle, we’d love to hear from you.



WHO WILL THRIVE HERE



Clear, Warm Communicator: You speak fluent, easy-to-understand English with natural phrasing and feel confident speaking with North American customers.



Meticulous & Reliable: You notice the small details and follow through on every task. In trade services, an unpassed message can cost a contractor a major job.



Self-Disciplined: You work well independently without needing someone watching over your shoulder.



Tech-Comfortable: You adapt quickly to modern cloud tools and software.



Bonus Points: Prior experience working in Jobber and answering calls for North American clients is a plus. Background in home services/trades (roofing, HVAC, plumbing, well drilling) is an even bigger plus.



REQUIREMENTS



- A modern, capable computer or laptop

- A reliable, wired noise-canceling headset

- A quiet, private workspace free from background noise

- High-speed internet with a concrete backup plan for power/internet interruptions

- A working webcam (used for team and client video check-ins)



Exclusive commitment: This is a full-time, dedicated position. We ask that your scheduled shift hours are strictly reserved for Winslow Pacific.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Total Monthly Package: PHP 52,300

- Base Pay: PHP 42,200

- Night Differential: PHP 3,570

- HMO / Health Allowance: PHP 2,000

- Remote Work Allowance: PHP 4,530 for internet/equipment needs



Additional Perks:



- Weekly Payouts: Paid every week via Wise - no waiting until the end of the month.

- 13th Month Pay: PHP 42,200 (paid early December).

- Paid Canadian Holidays: 11 BC statutory holidays per year.

- Paid Leave: 4% PTO accrual (approx. 10 paid days off per year).

- Birthday Off: Paid day off on your birthday.

- Performance Bonuses: Bonuses tied to personal and company achievements.

- Career Growth: Long-term stability with a company that prefers promoting from within.



HOW TO APPLY

To confirm you've read the full posting, please start your application with the word ISLAND.



Please send us:



A short introduction: A brief paragraph about yourself and why a permanent night shift fits your current schedule.



A 60–90 second voice recording or loom video (file or link): Introduce yourself, then briefly role-play answering the phone for a company called "Coastline Roofing" and taking a message from a homeowner dealing with a roof leak. (We're listening for natural warmth, tone, and clarity - not perfection!)



Your updated resume



Note: We review every application that includes these three items, but we cannot move forward without a voice recording or loom video.

title: Video Editor

You will edit video podcast episodes from raw footage into complete, polished productions. This includes creating compelling hooks, intros and outros, lower thirds, motion graphics, captions, transitions, B-roll, sound design, and other visual elements that make the content professional and enjoyable to watch.



You will also identify the strongest moments from each podcast and turn them into short, engaging video clips designed for social media. In addition to podcast content, you may be asked to edit other videos such as promotional content, educational videos, interviews, ads, and behind-the-scenes content.

Strong skills in captions, motion graphics, lower thirds, transitions, sound design, and colour correction.
